context.en-US: Once TFEB is phosphorylated at serine 211 by mTORC1, 14-3-3 proteins bind the phosphorylated motif and mask the transcription factor's nuclear localization signal. This cytosolic sequestration prevents TFEB from accessing CLEAR elements in the nucleus, thereby suppressing expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The 14-3-3 interaction thereby converts a single phosphorylation event into a durable spatial exclusion of TFEB. Disruption of this complex is a key step in starvation- and drug-induced TFEB activation.
context.zh-TW: 一旦 TFEB 被 mTORC1 在 serine 211 磷酸化，14-3-3 蛋白即結合該磷酸化基序並遮蔽轉錄因子的核定位信號。這種細胞質隔離阻止 TFEB 接近核內的 CLEAR 元件，從而抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現。14-3-3 的交互作用因此將單一磷酸化事件轉化為對 TFEB 的持久空間排除。此複合體的破壞是飢餓和藥物誘導 TFEB 活化中的關鍵步驟。

context.en-US: Mutations in ABCD1, encoding a peroxisomal ATP-binding cassette transporter for very-long-chain fatty acids (VLCFAs), cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (ALD). Impaired ABCD1 disrupts VLCFA import into peroxisomes for beta-oxidation, leading to toxic accumulation of VLCFAs in adrenal cortex and central nervous system white matter. The resulting demyelination and adrenal insufficiency define the clinical syndrome. The disorder illustrates how peroxisomal transport defects produce severe neurodegeneration and underscores the importance of peroxisomal lipid homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: ABCD1 的突變編碼一種用於極長鏈脂肪酸（VLCFA）的過氧化體 ATP 結合匣轉運蛋白，導致 X 連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症（ALD）。ABCD1 受損破壞了 VLCFA 輸入過氧化體進行 β 氧化的過程，導致 VLCFA 在腎上腺皮質和中樞神經系統白質中毒性累積。由此產生的脫髓鞘和腎上腺功能不全定義了臨床症候群。此障礙說明了過氧化體運輸缺陷如何產生嚴重的神經退化，並強調了過氧化體脂質恆定性的重要性。

context.en-US: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
context.zh-TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

context.en-US: ACAT1 acetylates TFEB at lysine 116, a residue also targeted by the deacetylase SIRT1, where acetylation can hinder TFEB binding to DNA and thereby modulate its activity. The opposing actions of ACAT1 (acetylase) and SIRT1 (deacetylase) at K116 create a dynamic equilibrium that tunes TFEB transcriptional output. Under conditions favoring SIRT1, deacetylation at K116 enhances nuclear TFEB function, whereas ACAT1-driven acetylation may restrain it. This lysine is therefore a focal point of acetylome control over the autophagy-lysosomal master regulator.
context.zh-TW: ACAT1 在 lysine 116 乙醯化 TFEB，此殘基亦為去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的標靶，在此處乙醯化可能妨礙 TFEB 與 DNA 的結合，從而調節其活性。ACAT1（乙醯酶）與 SIRT1（去乙醯酶）在 K116 上的相反作用，創造出一個調諧 TFEB 轉錄輸出的動態平衡。在有利於 SIRT1 的條件下，K116 的去乙醯化增強核內 TFEB 功能，而 ACAT1 驅動的乙醯化可能約束它。因此此離胺酸是乙醯體對自噬—溶酶體主調控因子控制的焦點。

context.en-US: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) acetylates TFEB at multiple lysines (K91, K103, K116, K430), an enzymatic activity that, in this context, promotes TFEB nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These acetylations counteract repressive deacetylation cycles and enhance TFEB's ability to engage CLEAR elements, thereby boosting autophagy-lysosomal transcription. The observation that ACAT1-mediated acetylation can be activatory contrasts with the repressive acetylation by GCN5 at other sites. The net effect depends on the specific lysine and cellular context, underscoring the complexity of TFEB acetylation.
context.zh-TW: 乙醯輔酶 A 乙醯轉移酶 1（ACAT1）在多個離胺酸（K91、K103、K116、K430）乙醯化 TFEB，在此脈絡下此酵素活性促進 TFEB 核轉運和 DNA 結合。這些乙醯化對抗抑制性的去乙醯化循環，並增強 TFEB 接合 CLEAR 元件的能力，從而提升自噬—溶酶體轉錄。ACAT1 介導的乙醯化可為活化性的此一觀察，與 GCN5 在其他位點的抑制性乙醯化形成對比。淨效應取決於特定離胺酸和細胞背景，凸顯了 TFEB 乙醯化的複雜性。

context.en-US: Akt activates mTORC1 by phosphorylating and inhibiting the TSC1/TSC2 complex (and PRAS40), thereby increasing Rheb-GTP and relieving the upstream brake on mTORC1. This places mTORC1 squarely downstream of the PI3K-Akt growth-factor signaling axis that promotes anabolism and suppresses autophagy. Akt-dependent mTORC1 activation is a hallmark of insulin/IGF-1 action and of many cancers with PI3K pathway mutations. The Akt-mTORC1 link is the principal route by which fed-state signals inhibit autophagic degradation.
context.zh-TW: Akt 透過磷酸化並抑制 TSC1/TSC2 複合物（以及 PRAS40）來活化 mTORC1，從而增加 Rheb-GTP 並解除 mTORC1 的上游制動。這將 mTORC1 明確地置於促進合成代謝並抑制自噬的 PI3K-Akt 生長因子信號軸下游。Akt 依賴的 mTORC1 活化是胰島素/IGF-1 作用以及許多帶有 PI3K 路徑突變之癌症的標記。Akt-mTORC1 連結是進食狀態信號抑制自噬降解的主要途徑。

context.en-US: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, a C-terminal residue within the regulatory cluster that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor downstream of insulin and growth-factor signaling. By adding to the phosphorylation state of TFEB, Akt reinforces the anabolic, autophagy-suppressed state promoted by PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling. This modification complements mTORC1-mediated marks and integrates proliferative cues with repression of degradative transcription. The Akt-TFEB link embeds TFEB within the canonical survival signaling network.
context.zh-TW: Akt 在 serine 467 磷酸化 TFEB，此 C 端殘基位於調節簇內，在胰島素和生長因子信號下游促進該轉錄因子的細胞質保留。透過增加 TFEB 的磷酸化狀態，Akt 強化了 PI3K-Akt-mTOR 信號所促進的合成代謝、自噬受抑制狀態。此修飾補充了 mTORC1 介導的標記，並將增生線索與降解轉錄的抑制整合起來。Akt-TFEB 連結將 TFEB 嵌入典型的存活信號網絡中。

context.en-US: AMPK is a canonical inducer of autophagy that responds to rising AMP/ATP ratios during metabolic stress by directly phosphorylating and activating ULK1 at sites that promote phagophore formation. Simultaneously, AMPK inhibits mTORC1 by phosphorylating TSC2 and the mTORC1 subunit Raptor, removing the dominant brake on autophagy. AMPK can also phosphorylate TFEB/STBD1 to further enhance autophagic and glycogenolytic responses. Through these parallel actions, AMPK couples cellular energy scarcity to the rapid deployment of autophagic degradation.
context.zh-TW: AMPK是自噬的典型誘導劑，在代謝壓力期間透過上升的AMP/ATP比值，直接磷酸化並活化促進吞噬泡形成的ULK1位點來回應。同時，AMPK透過磷酸化TSC2和mTORC1次單元Raptor來抑制mTORC1，移除對自噬的主要制動。AMPK還可磷酸化TFEB/STBD1以進一步增強自噬和糖原分解反應。透過這些並行作用，AMPK將細胞能量匱乏與自噬降解的快速部署耦合。

context.en-US: During caloric restriction, AMPK activates autophagy by sensing the elevated AMP/ATP ratio and directly phosphorylating ULK1 while inhibiting mTORC1 via TSC2 and Raptor phosphorylation. This dual action removes the principal brake on autophagy and simultaneously initiates phagophore formation. AMPK thereby serves as the executive enzyme translating energy scarcity into degradative activation. Its central role explains why CR-mimetics that activate AMPK recapitulate the autophagic benefits of dieting.
context.zh-TW: 在熱量限制期間，AMPK 透過感知升高的 AMP/ATP 比值並直接磷酸化 ULK1，同時經由 TSC2 和 Raptor 磷酸化抑制 mTORC1，來活化自噬。此雙重作用移除了自噬的主要制動，同時啟動吞噬體形成。因此 AMPK 作為將能量稀缺轉譯為降解活化的執行酵素。其中樞角色解釋了為何活化 AMPK 的熱量限制擬似物能重現節食的自噬益處。

context.en-US: AMPK inhibits mTORC1 through at least two parallel mechanisms during cellular energy depletion: it phosphorylates and activates the TSC2 subunit of the TSC complex, and it directly phosphorylates the mTORC1 scaffold Raptor. These actions reduce Rheb-GTP levels and impair mTORC1 substrate engagement, thereby relieving repression of autophagy. AMPK thus couples the AMP/ATP energy charge to suppression of anabolic mTORC1 signaling. This inhibition is a primary route by which exercise, metformin, and caloric restriction induce autophagy.
context.zh-TW: AMPK 在細胞能量耗竭期間透過至少兩條平行機制抑制 mTORC1：它磷酸化並活化 TSC 複合物的 TSC2 次單元，並直接磷酸化 mTORC1 支架蛋白 Raptor。這些作用降低 Rheb-GTP 水平並損害 mTORC1 受質接合，從而解除對自噬的抑制。因此 AMPK 將 AMP/ATP 能量電荷耦合到合成代謝 mTORC1 信號的抑制。此抑制是運動、metformin 和熱量限制誘導自噬的主要途徑。

context.en-US: AMPK phosphorylates TFEB on a cluster of serine residues (S466, S467, S469) located in its C-terminal regulatory region in response to energy stress. These phosphorylations enhance TFEB transcriptional activity and promote its nuclear accumulation, synergizing with the relief of mTORC1 repression. The modification thereby directly couples low cellular energy status to activation of the autophagy-lysosomal transcriptional program. This AMPK-TFEB axis provides a transcription-level reinforcement of the rapid post-translational induction of autophagy.
context.zh-TW: AMPK 在能量壓力下，於其 C 端調節區的絲胺酸殘基簇（S466、S467、S469）磷酸化 TFEB。這些磷酸化增強 TFEB 轉錄活性並促進其核累積，與 mTORC1 抑制的解除產生協同。此修飾因此直接將低細胞能量狀態耦合到自噬—溶酶體轉錄程序的活化。此 AMPK-TFEB 軸提供了對自噬快速轉譯後誘導的轉錄層次強化。

context.en-US: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
context.zh-TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

subject: Atg4B

context.en-US: The small-molecule ATG4B inhibitor S130 blocks the cysteine protease required for LC3 processing and autophagosome maturation; when combined with caloric restriction, this inhibition shifts the balance toward apoptotic death in colorectal cancer cells. By preventing autophagic protection of tumor cells while CR imposes metabolic stress, S130 sensitizes malignancy to cell death. The synergy illustrates a therapeutic strategy of pairing CR or CR-mimetics with targeted autophagy inhibition in cancer. The approach exploits the reliance of some tumors on basal autophagy for survival.
context.zh-TW: 小分子 ATG4B 抑制劑 S130 阻斷 LC3 處理和自噬體成熟所需的半胱氨酸蛋白酶；當與熱量限制結合時，此抑制在大腸癌細胞中將平衡推向凋亡性死亡。透過防止腫瘤細胞的自噬保護，同時熱量限制施加代謝壓力，S130 使惡性腫瘤對細胞死亡敏感化。此協同作用說明了一種將熱量限制或熱量限制擬似物與標靶性自噬抑制配對用於癌症的治療策略。此方法利用了某些腫瘤對基礎自噬存活的依賴。

context.en-US: Autophagic flux—the complete rate of cargo delivery to and degradation within lysosomes—declines progressively with age in many tissues. This decline stems from impaired initiation, reduced lysosomal proteolytic capacity, and accumulated lipofuscin that compromises lysosomal function, producing a state of proteostatic insufficiency. The resulting accumulation of damaged organelles and protein aggregates contributes centrally to the aging phenotype and to age-related diseases such as neurodegeneration and sarcopenia. Restoration of autophagic flux is therefore a major hypothesized mechanism through which longevity interventions exert their benefits.
context.zh-TW: 自噬流——即貨物遞送至溶酶體及在溶酶體內降解的完整速率——在許多組織中隨年齡漸進下降。此下降源於起始受損、溶酶體蛋白水解能力降低，以及累積的脂褐質損害溶酶體功能，產生蛋白質穩態不足的狀態。由此導致的受損胞器和蛋白聚集物累積，對老化表型和神經退化、肌肉減少症等與年齡相關疾病有核心貢獻。因此，恢復自噬流是長壽介入發揮其益處的一個主要假設機制。

context.en-US: Autophagic lysosome reformation (ALR) is the process by which spent autolysosomes tubulate and bud off new lysosomes to restore the lysosomal pool after autophagy. ALR requires the coordinated actions of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2), clathrin, and adaptor proteins AP2 and AP4 to drive membrane scission and vesicle formation. This reformation step is essential to prevent lysosomal depletion during sustained autophagy. Defects in ALR cause accumulation of enlarged autolysosomes and impaired degradative capacity.
context.zh-TW: 自噬性溶酶體重組（ALR）是耗損的自體溶酶體經由小管形成並出芽產生新溶酶體，以在自噬後恢復溶酶體庫的過程。ALR 需要磷脂醯肌醇 4,5-二磷酸（PI(4,5)P2）、clathrin 以及接頭蛋白 AP2 與 AP4 的協調作用，以驅動膜分裂和囊泡形成。此重組步驟對防止持續自噬期間溶酶體耗竭至為必要。ALR 的缺陷導致腫大的自體溶酶體累積以及降解能力受損。

context.en-US: Autophagy prevents arterial aging by removing damaged mitochondria, misfolded proteins, and lipid aggregates that would otherwise promote endothelial dysfunction, inflammation, and vascular stiffening. Impaired autophagic flux in aged vessels permits oxidative stress and senescence to accumulate, driving the loss of nitric-oxide-mediated relaxation. Enhancing autophagy—pharmacologically or by caloric restriction—rescues the vascular phenotype and restores endothelial function in preclinical models. The pathway is thus a central defender of vascular youth.
context.zh-TW: 自噬透過移除受損粒線體、錯誤折疊蛋白和脂質聚集物來防止動脈老化，這些物質否則會促進內皮功能障礙、發炎和血管僵硬化。老化血管中自噬流受損會讓氧化壓力和衰老累積，驅動一氧化氮介導舒張能力的喪失。增強自噬——藥理學上或透過熱量限制——在臨床前模型中拯救血管表型並恢復內皮功能。因此此途徑是血管年輕的主要守護者。

context.en-US: Autophagy exerts a context-dependent, dual role in cancer that is determined by tumor stage, genetic background, and microenvironment. In initiated cells and early neoplasia, basal autophagy acts as a tumor-suppressive quality-control mechanism by removing damaged mitochondria, suppressing oxidative stress, and limiting genomic instability and inflammation. In established tumors, however, autophagy is frequently upregulated and co-opted to support the metabolic demands of rapidly proliferating cancer cells and to promote survival under hypoxia, nutrient limitation, and therapy. This dualism means that autophagy inhibition can be either anti-tumor or, paradoxically, tumor-promoting, depending on context.
context.zh-TW: 自噬在癌症中發揮依情境而定的雙重角色，由腫瘤分期、遺傳背景和微環境決定。在起始細胞和早期腫瘤發生中，基礎自噬透過移除受損粒線體、抑制氧化壓力和限制基因組不穩定與發炎，作為腫瘤抑制性的品質控制機制。然而，在已形成的腫瘤中，自噬經常上調並被徵用以支持快速增殖癌細胞的代謝需求，並促進在缺氧、營養限制和治療下的存活。這種雙重性意味著自噬抑制可以是抗腫瘤的，或者矛盾地是促腫瘤的，取決於情境。

context.en-US: During cancer treatment, autophagy plays a dual role that depends on context: it can protect tumor cells from chemotherapy- and radiation-induced damage, limiting therapeutic efficacy, yet it can also promote therapy-induced cell death when excessive or when it facilitates terminal differentiation and antigen presentation. In normal tissues, treatment-induced autophagy is generally cytoprotective and reduces toxicity, widening the therapeutic window. The opposing outcomes necessitate careful stratification of when to inhibit versus enhance autophagy in the clinic. This duality mirrors autophagy's broader role in cancer initiation versus progression.
context.zh-TW: 在癌症治療期間，自噬扮演依脈絡而定的雙重角色：它可保護腫瘤細胞免於化療和放療引起的損傷，限制治療效能，但它也可在過度或促進終末分化和抗原呈現時，促進治療誘發的細胞死亡。在正常組織中，治療誘發的自噬通常是細胞保護性的並減少毒性，拓寬治療窗口。相反的結果要求在臨床上仔細分層何時抑制 versus 增強自噬。此雙重性反映了自噬在癌症起始與進展中更廣泛的角色。

context.en-US: Chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) is a selective form of lysosomal degradation in which individual soluble cytosolic proteins bearing a pentapeptide KFERQ-like targeting motif are recognized by the cytosolic chaperone HSC70. The substrate-chaperone complex is then delivered to the lysosomal membrane, where the receptor LAMP-2A monomers translocate the unfolded substrate across the membrane into the lumen for degradation. Unlike macro- and microautophagy, CMA degrades one protein at a time and does not require membrane engulfment or autophagosome formation. CMA activity declines with age and is implicated in neurodegeneration and cancer, and it is subject to regulation by mTORC2 and other signaling nodes.
context.zh-TW: 伴護蛋白介導的自噬（CMA）是一種選擇性的溶酶體降解形式，其中帶有五肽KFERQ樣標靶基序的個別可溶性細胞質蛋白被細胞質伴護蛋白HSC70辨識。隨後受質—伴護蛋白複合體被遞送至溶酶體膜，由受體LAMP-2A單體將未折疊的受質跨膜轉運至腔內進行降解。不同於巨自噬和微自噬，CMA一次降解一個蛋白質，且不需要膜吞噬或自噬體形成。CMA活性隨年齡下降，並與神經退化和癌症有關，且受mTORC2和其他訊號節點的調控。

context.en-US: Intermittent fasting (IF) is a dietary intervention that periodically restricts caloric intake, producing the nutrient deprivation signals that robustly induce autophagy in many tissues. In preclinical cancer models, cycles of IF combined with chemotherapy have been shown to slow tumor growth and improve therapeutic index by exploiting the differential stress resistance of normal versus malignant cells. The protective effect of autophagy during fasting helps normal cells tolerate chemotherapy, while many tumors remain reliant on constitutive autophagy for survival. These findings position IF as a translational strategy to modulate autophagic tone for anti-cancer and pro-longevity benefits.
context.zh-TW: 間歇性斷食（IF）是一種週期性限制熱量攝取的飲食介入，產生營養剝奪訊號，在許多組織中強力誘導自噬。在臨床前癌症模型中，IF週期與化療相結合已被證明可減緩腫瘤生長並改善治療指數，這是透過利用正常細胞與惡性細胞的差異性壓力抵抗。斷食期間自噬的保護作用幫助正常細胞耐受化療，而許多腫瘤仍依賴組成型自噬以存活。這些發現將IF定位為一種轉譯策略，用於調節自噬張力以獲得抗癌和促長壽的益處。

context.en-US: Autophagy is a conserved lysosome-dependent catabolic process in which cytoplasmic constituents—including misfolded proteins, protein aggregates, damaged organelles, and intracellular pathogens—are sequestered into double-membrane autophagosomes and delivered to lysosomes for enzymatic degradation. The resulting macromolecular building blocks such as amino acids, fatty acids, and nucleotides are recycled to sustain metabolism and biosynthetic capacity during nutrient stress. As the cell's principal quality-control and nutrient-recycling system, autophagy is essential for maintaining proteostasis and organellar integrity across nearly all eukaryotic cells. Defects in autophagic flux are causally linked to aging, neurodegeneration, cancer, and metabolic disease, making it a central node in cellular homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: 自噬是一種保守的、依賴溶酶體的分解代謝過程，其中細胞質成分——包括錯誤折疊蛋白、蛋白聚集物、受損胞器和細胞內病原體——被隔離進入雙層膜自噬體，並遞送至溶酶體進行酶解降解。所產生的巨分子建構單元如胺基酸、脂肪酸和核苷酸被回收，以在營養壓力下維持代謝和生合成能力。作為細胞主要的品質控制和營養回收系統，自噬對於在幾乎所有真核細胞中維持蛋白質穩態和胞器完整性至關重要。自噬流缺陷與老化、神經退化、癌症和代謝疾病有因果關聯，使其成為細胞穩態中的核心節點。

context.en-US: Macroautophagy (commonly termed autophagy) is the best-characterized form, in which a de novo formed double-membrane structure called the phagophore expands to engulf cytoplasmic cargo and seals into an autophagosome. The autophagosome then fuses with a lysosome, forming an autolysosome where luminal contents are degraded by acidic hydrolases. This bulk and selective degradative route is orchestrated by the conserved ATG machinery, including the ULK1 initiation complex and the PI3K III/Beclin 1 nucleation complex. Macroautophagy is the dominant pathway induced by starvation, stress, and many pharmacological interventions and is the primary focus of most therapeutic autophagy modulation.
context.zh-TW: 巨自噬（通常稱為自噬）是特徵最清楚的形式，其中一種稱為吞噬泡、從頭形成的雙層膜結構擴展以吞噬細胞質貨物並封閉成自噬體。自噬體隨後與溶酶體融合，形成自噬溶酶體，其腔內容物被酸性水解酶降解。此種大規模且選擇性的降解途徑由保守的ATG機制協調，包括ULK1起始複合體和PI3K III/Beclin 1成核複合體。巨自噬是由飢餓、壓力和許多藥理介入所誘導的主要途徑，也是大多數治療性自噬調控的主要焦點。

context.en-US: Microautophagy involves the direct engulfment of cytoplasmic cargo by the lysosomal (or vacuolar) membrane through invagination, tubulation, or protrusion of the limiting membrane, without the requirement for a distinct autophagosome intermediate. The entrapped material is then internalized into the lysosomal lumen for degradation, a process that is particularly prominent in yeast vacuoles and in mammalian late endosomes/multivesicular bodies. Compared with macroautophagy, microautophagy operates with less selectivity and is regulated by distinct machineries, though it similarly contributes to organelle and protein turnover. It plays roles in lipid droplet turnover, membrane protein degradation, and quality control under both basal and stress conditions.
context.zh-TW: 微自噬涉及溶酶體（或液泡）膜透過界膜的內陷、成管或突起直接吞噬細胞質貨物，不需要獨立的自噬體中間體。被困住的物質隨後被內化進入溶酶體腔進行降解，此過程在酵母液泡和哺乳動物晚期內體／多泡體中特別顯著。與巨自噬相比，微自噬的選擇性較低，並由不同的機制調控，儘管它同樣有助於胞器和蛋白質的更新。它在脂滴更新、膜蛋白降解以及基礎和壓力條件下的品質控制中發揮作用。

context.en-US: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
context.zh-TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

context.en-US: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
context.zh-TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

context.en-US: Calcineurin, a calcium/calmodulin-dependent serine-threonine phosphatase, dephosphorylates TFEB at serine 211, reversing the mTORC1-mediated mark that anchors it in the cytosol. Removal of the phosphate disrupts 14-3-3 binding and unmasks the nuclear localization signal, permitting TFEB nuclear translocation. This calcium-dependent dephosphorylation couples lysosomal calcium release—triggered by TRPML1—to activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program. Calcineurin therefore provides the phosphatasic counterbalance that licenses TFEB activity during stress.
context.zh-TW: Calcineurin 是一種鈣／鈣調蛋白依賴型絲胺酸-蘇胺酸磷酸酶，在 serine 211 去磷酸化 TFEB，逆轉將其錨定於細胞質的 mTORC1 介導標記。磷酸根的移除破壞 14-3-3 結合並揭露核定位信號，允許 TFEB 核轉運。這種依賴鈣的去磷酸化將溶酶體鈣釋放——由 TRPML1 觸發——耦合到自噬—溶酶體程序的活化。因此 calcineurin 提供了在壓力期間許可 TFEB 活性的磷酸酶平衡力。

context.en-US: Moderate caloric restriction induces adaptive autophagy—a beneficial, hormetic form of the pathway that enhances cellular clearance and resilience without causing damage. This adaptive response, driven by AMPK activation and mTORC1 inhibition, contributes substantially to the lifespan and healthspan extension observed with CR. Unlike pathological autophagy, adaptive autophagy is precisely regulated and supports rather than threatens cell survival. It represents the mechanistic core of CR's pro-longevity effects.
context.zh-TW: 適度的熱量限制誘發適應性自噬——一種有益的、激效型（hormetic）的途徑形式，在不造成損傷的情況下增強細胞清除和韌性。此由 AMPK 活化和 mTORC1 抑制驅動的適應性反應，對熱量限制所觀察到的壽命和健康壽命延長貢獻良多。不同於病理性自噬，適應性自噬受到精確調節，支持而非威脅細胞存活。它代表了熱量限制促長壽效應的機制核心。

context.en-US: Caloric restriction increases the sensitivity of tumor cells to chemotherapy by creating a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while cancer cells remain vulnerable. CR additionally stimulates CD8+ T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity and enhances apoptotic priming of malignant cells. The improved therapeutic index allows lower effective doses and reduced toxicity. These effects position CR and its mimetics as adjuncts to conventional cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: 熱量限制透過創造差異性壓力抵抗來增加腫瘤細胞對化療的敏感性：正常細胞進入保護性、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而癌細胞仍保持脆弱。熱量限制還刺激 CD8+ T 細胞介導的抗腫瘤免疫，並增強惡性細胞的凋亡啟動。改善的治療指數允許更低的有效劑量和減少的毒性。這些效應將熱量限制及其擬似物定位為常規癌症治療的輔助手段。

context.en-US: Prolonged or severe caloric restriction can drive excessive autophagy that crosses into autophagic cell death, particularly when degradative flux outpaces biosynthetic capacity. This maladaptive extreme underscores the biphasic, hormetic nature of autophagy, where too little or too much is detrimental. The balance between adaptive and excessive autophagy determines whether CR is protective or harmful. Understanding this threshold is important for safely translating CR-mimetic strategies.
context.zh-TW: 長期或嚴重的熱量限制可能驅動過度的自噬，跨越到自噬性細胞死亡，特別是當降解流超越合成能力時。此適應不良的極端凸顯了自噬的雙相、激效型本質，即過少或過多都有害。適應性與過度自噬之間的平衡決定了熱量限制是有保護性還是有害。理解此閾值對於安全轉譯熱量限制擬似策略至為重要。

context.en-US: Caloric restriction and rapamycin are alternative inducers of autophagy that, like spermidine, engage the lysosomal-degradative program to promote healthspan, but each carries translational limitations. Caloric restriction is difficult to sustain long-term in humans and can have adverse metabolic consequences, while rapamycin has immunosuppressive and potential metabolic side effects. Spermidine offers a more tractable, well-tolerated means to mimic these benefits through safe autophagy induction. The existence of multiple inducers provides flexibility in designing anti-aging interventions.
context.zh-TW: 熱量限制和雷帕黴素是自噬的替代性誘發物，它們如同精胺一般，運用溶酶體—降解程序來促進健康壽命，但各自帶有轉譯限制。熱量限制難以在人類中長期維持，且可能有不良代謝後果，而雷帕黴素具有免疫抑制和潛在代謝副作用。精胺提供了一種更可行、耐受性良好的方式，透過安全的自噬誘發來模擬這些益處。多種誘發物的存在為設計抗衰老介入提供了靈活性。

context.en-US: Caloric restriction mimetics are pharmacological agents that reproduce the metabolic and autophagic benefits of caloric restriction without sustained food reduction. Representatives such as 2-deoxyglucose, metformin, and spermidine activate AMPK and/or inhibit mTORC1, recapitulating the low-energy signaling state that drives autophagy. By mimicking nutrient scarcity at the signaling level, these compounds induce lysosomal and autophagic gene programs similar to those engaged during DR. They are attractive translationally because they avoid the practical and compliance limitations of long-term dietary restriction in humans.
context.zh-TW: 熱量限制擬似物是能再現熱量限制的代謝和自噬益處而無需持續減少食物的藥理劑。代表物如2-deoxyglucose、metformin和spermidine活化AMPK和／或抑制mTORC1，重現驅動自噬的低能量訊號狀態。透過在訊號層面模擬營養匱乏，這些化合物誘導與DR期間相似的溶酶體和自噬基因程序。它們在轉譯上具吸引力，因為它們避免了人類長期飲食限制的實際和依從性限制。

context.en-US: Catalase, constitutively present in the peroxisomal matrix, decomposes hydrogen peroxide — a toxic byproduct of peroxisomal oxidase reactions — into water and oxygen (2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2). This makes peroxisomes central to cellular detoxification of reactive oxygen species.
context.zh-TW: Catalase 恆定存在於過氧化體基質中，可將過氧化氫（過氧化物體氧化酶反應產生的毒性副產物）分解為水與氧（2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2）。這使過氧化物體成為細胞解毒活性氧族群的核心場所。

context.en-US: CD73, the rate-limiting ectonucleotidase that converts AMP to immunosuppressive adenosine in the tumor microenvironment, is downregulated following intermittent fasting. Reduced CD73 expression leads to diminished extracellular adenosine, which can relieve adenosine-mediated immune suppression and enhance anti-tumor immunity. The regulation is observed in vitro under fasting-mimetic conditions, linking IF to both metabolic and immunological remodeling. Because adenosine signaling promotes tumor evasion, CD73 downregulation represents a plausible mechanism by which fasting improves cancer therapy outcomes.
context.zh-TW: CD73是腫瘤微環境中將AMP轉化為免疫抑制性腺苷的限速胞外核苷酸酶，在間歇性斷食後下調。CD73表現降低導致細胞外腺苷減少，可緩解腺苷介導的免疫抑制並增強抗腫瘤免疫。此調節在體外斷食模擬條件下觀察到，將IF與代謝和免疫重塑連結。由於腺苷訊號促進腫瘤逃避免疫，CD73下調代表斷食改善癌症治療結果的一個合理機制。

context.en-US: Cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6), central drivers of G1 cell-cycle progression, phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142 and promote its nuclear export through a CRM1-dependent mechanism. This action sequesters TFEB in the cytoplasm during phases of active proliferation, when degradative programs are downregulated. Conversely, pharmacological CDK4/6 inhibition permits TFEB nuclear retention and enhances lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. The CDK4/6-TFEB link couples cell-cycle state to the metabolic and degradative status of the cell.
context.zh-TW: 細胞週期蛋白依賴型激酶 4 和 6（CDK4/6）是 G1 細胞週期進展的核心驅動者，於 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，並透過 CRM1 依賴機制促進其核輸出。此作用在降解程序下調的主動增殖階段，將 TFEB 隔離於細胞質中。相反地，藥理 CDK4/6 抑制允許 TFEB 核保留並增強溶酶體生物發生和自噬。CDK4/6-TFEB 連結將細胞週期狀態耦合到細胞的代謝和降解狀態。

context.en-US: CDK4/6 phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142, driving CRM1-dependent nuclear export and cytoplasmic sequestration during cell-cycle progression. This modification aligns TFEB repression with the biosynthetic demands of dividing cells, when autophagy is downregulated. Pharmacologic CDK4/6 inhibitors relieve this constraint, permitting TFEB nuclear accumulation and enhancing lysosome biogenesis and autophagic flux. The axis thereby couples cell-cycle machinery to the metabolic state of the cell.
context.zh-TW: CDK4/6 在 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，驅動 CRM1 依賴的核輸出以及在細胞週期進展期間的細胞質隔離。此修飾將 TFEB 抑制與分裂細胞的生物合成需求對齊，此時自噬被下調。藥理 CDK4/6 抑制劑解除此約束，允許 TFEB 核累積並增強溶酶體生物發生與自噬流。該軸因而將細胞週期機制與細胞的代謝狀態耦合。

context.en-US: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
context.zh-TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。

context.en-US: Cisplatin is a platinum-based chemotherapeutic whose efficacy is augmented when combined with intermittent fasting in both cellular and animal models. Fasting generates a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while many tumor cells remain vulnerable to platinum-DNA adduct formation. The improved therapeutic window reduces chemotherapy-associated toxicity while slowing tumor growth, suggesting a combinatorial strategy. These findings support IF as an adjunct to sensitize tumors and protect host tissue during cisplatin-based regimens.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin是一種鉑類化療藥，在細胞和動物模型中與間歇性斷食合併使用時其療效增強。斷食產生一種差異性壓力抵抗，其中正常細胞進入保護性的、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而許多腫瘤細胞仍易受鉑—DNA加合物形成的影響。改善的治療窗口在減緩腫瘤生長的同時降低化療相關毒性，提示一種組合策略。這些發現支持將IF作為輔助手段，在以cisplatin為基礎的療程中增敏腫瘤並保護宿主組織。

context.en-US: DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor ortholog, partially regulates MXL-3 expression such that impaired insulin signaling leads to modest repression of mxl-3 transcription. This places MXL-3 downstream of the insulin-signaling axis that broadly controls metabolism and longevity in worms. The partial effect indicates that additional nutrient and developmental inputs also govern mxl-3, consistent with its role as a multifactorial repressor. The linkage reinforces the canonical insulin→autophagy/lipid regulatory cascade.
context.zh-TW: DAF-2 是線蟲的胰島素/IGF-1 受體同源物，部分調節 MXL-3 表現，使得胰島素信號受損會導致 mxl-3 轉錄的適度抑制。這將 MXL-3 置於廣泛控制線蟲代謝和長壽的胰島素信號軸下游。此部分效應表明額外的營養和發育輸入也控制 mxl-3，與其作為多因子抑制因子的角色一致。此連結強化了典型的胰島素→自噬/脂質調節級聯。

context.en-US: Deptor is an endogenous inhibitor that binds both mTORC1 and mTORC2, suppressing the catalytic activity of each complex. By dampening both arms of mTOR signaling, Deptor broadly restrains anabolic growth, survival, and autophagy suppression. Its expression is itself feedback-regulated by mTORC1/mTORC2 activity, forming part of a homeostatic loop. Reduced Deptor levels in certain cancers correlate with hyperactive mTOR signaling, highlighting its tumor-suppressive potential.
context.zh-TW: Deptor 是一種內生抑制劑，結合 mTORC1 和 mTORC2 兩者，抑制各複合物的催化活性。透過阻尼 mTOR 信號的兩條臂，Deptor 廣泛地約束合成代謝生長、存活和自噬抑制。其表現本身受 mTORC1/mTORC2 活性回饋調節，構成恆定性迴圈的一部分。某些癌症中 Deptor 水平降低與過度活化的 mTOR 信號相關，凸顯了其腫瘤抑制潛力。

context.en-US: Dietary restriction (DR) and its variants are among the most potent physiological activators of autophagy, engaging the pathway in most cultured cells and across many organs in vivo. By lowering circulating nutrients and insulin while raising AMP/ATP ratios, DR relieves mTORC1 inhibition and activates AMPK, thereby de-repressing the ULK1 complex and TFEB-dependent lysosomal programs. In model organisms such as C. elegans, DR induces autophagy through coordinated transcriptional changes mediated by orthologs like HLH-30/TFEB. The health- and lifespan-extending effects of DR are widely attributed in substantial part to this induction of adaptive autophagy.
context.zh-TW: 飲食限制（DR）及其變體是最強效的自噬生理活化因子之一，在大多數培養細胞和體內許多器官中啟動該途徑。透過降低循環營養素和胰島素，同時提高AMP/ATP比值，DR解除mTORC1的抑制並活化AMPK，從而解除對ULK1複合體和TFEB依賴性溶酶體程序的抑制。在如C. elegans等模式生物中，DR透過HLH-30/TFEB等同源蛋白介導的協調轉錄變化誘導自噬。DR促進健康和延長壽命的效應，在很大程度上被歸因於此適應性自噬的誘導。

context.en-US: Eltrombopag (EO), a small-molecule thrombopoietin receptor agonist, was identified as the first direct inhibitor of TFEB, disrupting TFEB-DNA interactions at CLEAR elements. By preventing TFEB from binding its target promoters, EO blocks transcriptional activation of the autophagy-lysosomal network. This tool compound has enabled dissection of TFEB-dependent versus independent autophagy and has therapeutic implications where TFEB hyperactivation is pathogenic. Its discovery established pharmacological feasibility of directly targeting the MiT/TFE family.
context.zh-TW: Eltrombopag（EO）是一種小分子 thrombopoietin 受體促效劑，被鑑定為第一個 TFEB 的直接抑制劑，破壞 TFEB 在 CLEAR 元件處的 TFEB-DNA 交互作用。透過阻止 TFEB 結合其標的啟動子，EO 阻斷自噬—溶酶體網絡的轉錄活化。此工具化合物使得剖析 TFEB 依賴與非依賴的自噬成為可能，並在 TFEB 過度活化為致病性的情況下具有治療意義。其發現確立了直接標靶 MiT/TFE 家族的藥理可行性。

context.en-US: ERK2, a member of the MAPK family activated downstream of growth factor and mitogenic signaling, phosphorylates TFEB at serine 142. This phosphorylation promotes cytosolic retention of TFEB, analogous to the regulatory effect of mTORC1 at nearby sites, thereby limiting nuclear accumulation. The ERK2-TFEB connection integrates proliferative signaling with suppression of the degradative program in growing cells. It illustrates that TFEB localization is governed by multiple kinase inputs beyond the core mTOR axis.
context.zh-TW: ERK2 是 MAPK 家族的成員，在生長因子和有絲分裂信號下游被活化，於 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB。此磷酸化促進 TFEB 的細胞質保留，類似 mTORC1 在鄰近位點的調節效應，從而限制核累積。ERK2-TFEB 連結將增生信號與生長中細胞降解程序的抑制整合起來。它說明了 TFEB 定位受核心 mTOR 軸之外的多種激酶輸入所控制。

context.en-US: Akt phosphorylates and inhibits the FOXO1/FOXO3 transcription factors, which normally promote autophagy and stress-resistance gene expression, thereby indirectly suppressing autophagy downstream of insulin/PI3K signaling. The reciprocal interaction reflects the broader antagonism between growth-factor-driven anabolism (via Akt-mTOR) and the autophagy-promoting FOXO program. When Akt is inactive during fasting, FOXO factors are de-repressed and contribute to autophagic and longevity pathways. This axis embeds autophagy control within the insulin-signaling network that also regulates mTORC1.
context.zh-TW: Akt 磷酸化並抑制 FOXO1/FOXO3 轉錄因子，後者通常促進自噬和壓力抵抗基因表現，從而在胰島素/PI3K 信號下游間接抑制自噬。此相互關係反映了生長因子驅動的合成代謝（經由 Akt-mTOR）與促自噬 FOXO 程序之間更廣泛的拮抗。當禁食期間 Akt 失活時，FOXO 因子被解除抑制並貢獻於自噬和長壽途徑。此軸將自噬控制嵌入同時調節 mTORC1 的胰島素信號網絡中。

context.en-US: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
context.zh-TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

context.en-US: The deamination of glutamine by glutaminase releases ammonium, which raises cytosolic pH and acts as a signaling molecule. This ammonia signal induces cytoprotective autophagy as a response to nutrient and therapeutic stress. The ammonia-autophagy axis highlights glutaminase as a bridge between nutrient sensing and cellular resilience. Ammonium production thereby couples glutamine catabolism to the stress-response program.
context.zh-TW: Glutaminase 對麩醯胺酸的去胺化釋放銨，它提高細胞質 pH 並作為訊號分子。此氨訊號誘導保護性自噬，作為對營養和治療壓力的反應。氨—自噬軸凸顯 glutaminase 作為營養感知與細胞韌性之間的橋樑。因此銨的產生將麩醯胺分解代謝耦合到壓力反應程序。

context.en-US: Glutaminase-generated ammonium induces cytoprotective autophagy as a response to nutrient and therapeutic stress. By raising cytosolic pH, the ammonia released from glutamine deamidation signals the cell to engage autophagic clearance. This links glutamine metabolism to the autophagy-lysosomal program and cellular resilience. The coupling is especially relevant in aging and in the response of cancer cells to therapy.
context.zh-TW: Glutaminase 所產生的銨誘導保護性自噬，作為對營養和治療壓力的反應。透過提高細胞質 pH，麩醯胺去胺化釋放的氨向細胞發出訊息以啟動自噬性清除。這將麩醯胺代謝與自噬—溶酶體程序和細胞韌性連結起來。此耦合在老化和癌細胞對治療的反應中尤其相關。

context.en-US: CB-839 (telaglenastat), along with BPTES and JHU083, is a pharmacological glutaminase inhibitor that reduces autophagic flux and lowers alpha-ketoglutarate levels. Inhibiting glutaminase sensitizes tumor cells to chemotherapy and targeted agents, making GLS a candidate vulnerability in cancer metabolism. In MYC-high models, CB-839 combined with Complex I inhibitors produces persistent tumor suppression. However, CB-839 monotherapy showed limited antitumor activity in unselected triple-negative breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: CB-839（telaglenastat）與 BPTES 和 JHU083 同為藥理學 glutaminase 抑制劑，可降低自噬流並降低 alpha-ketoglutarate 水平。抑制 glutaminase 可使腫瘤細胞對化療和標靶藥物增敏，使 GLS 成為癌症代謝中的候選脆弱點。在 MYC 高表現模型中，CB-839 與 Complex I 抑制劑合併產生持久的腫瘤抑制。然而 CB-839 單藥在未經篩選的三陰性乳腺癌中顯示有限的抗腫瘤活性。

context.en-US: Two major glutaminase isoforms exist: kidney-type GLS1 (encoded by GLS, with alternatively spliced variants KGA and GAC) and liver-type GLS2 (encoded by GLS2). GLS1 is the predominant isoform in most proliferating cells and is allosterically activated by phosphate and glutamate. The tumor suppressor p53 transcriptionally induces GLS2. Both isoforms are mitochondrial matrix enzymes.
context.zh-TW: 存在兩種主要的 glutaminase 同型異構物：腎型 GLS1（由 GLS 編碼，具選擇性剪接變異 KGA 和 GAC）和肝型 GLS2（由 GLS2 編碼）。GLS1 是大多數增殖細胞中的主要同型異構物，受磷酸和麩胺酸異位性活化。腫瘤抑制因子 p53 轉錄誘導 GLS2。兩種同型異構物都是粒線體基質酵素。

context.en-US: Glutaminase catalyzes the hydrolytic deamidation of glutamine to glutamate and ammonium, the rate-limiting first step of glutaminolysis. The glutamate produced is further transaminated to alpha-ketoglutarate, replenishing TCA-cycle intermediates (anaplerosis). This reaction is essential for glutamine-dependent cancers, which rely on glutamine as a major carbon and nitrogen source. The enzyme's activity is allosterically activated by inorganic phosphate and by its product glutamate at high concentrations.
context.zh-TW: Glutaminase 催化麩醯胺酸水解性去胺化為麩胺酸和銨，這是麩醯胺分解的限速第一步。所產生的麩胺酸進一步轉胺為 alpha-ketoglutarate，補充 TCA 循環中間物（anaplerosis）。此反應對依賴麩醯胺的癌症至關重要，因為它們以麩醯胺作為主要碳源和氮源。此酵素活性受無機磷酸以及高濃度產物麩胺酸的異位性活化。

context.en-US: Glutaminase (GLS) is a mitochondrial matrix enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolytic deamidation of glutamine to glutamate and ammonium, the committed first step of glutaminolysis. Both major isoforms (GLS1 and GLS2) require oligomerization for catalytic activity and are localized to the mitochondria. By linking amino acid catabolism to the TCA cycle and redox balance, glutaminase sits at the hub of cellular metabolism. Its mitochondrial localization is central to its role in fueling proliferating cells.
context.zh-TW: Glutaminase（GLS）是一種粒線體基質酵素，催化麩醯胺酸水解性去胺化為麩胺酸和銨，是麩醯胺分解的代謝第一步。兩種主要同型異構物（GLS1 和 GLS2）都需要寡聚化才具有催化活性，並定位於粒線體。透過將胺基酸分解代謝與 TCA 循環和氧化還原平衡連結，glutaminase 位居細胞代謝的核心。其粒線體定位對其供給增殖細胞的角色至關重要。

context.en-US: Glutaminase-derived glutamate can be converted to glutathione, a key antioxidant that buffers reactive oxygen species and supports redox balance. Through this route, glutaminolysis ties into oxidative stress defense and cellular resilience. The glutamate also feeds NADPH production via malic enzyme, contributing to redox homeostasis. This antioxidant dimension links glutamine metabolism to protection against oxidative damage.
context.zh-TW: Glutaminase 衍生的麩胺酸可轉化為麩胱甘肽，一種緩衝活性氧並支持氧化還原平衡的關鍵抗氧化劑。透過此途徑，麩醯胺分解與氧化壓力防禦和細胞韌性相連。麩胺酸也經由蘋果酸酶供應 NADPH 生產，貢獻於氧化還原恆定性。此抗氧化面向將麩醯胺代謝與對抗氧化損傷的保護連結起來。

context.en-US: In pancreatic cancer, TFEB-mediated glutaminase upregulation supports tumor metabolism by supplying the glutamine-derived carbon and nitrogen needed for growth. Glutaminolysis is a hallmark of rapidly dividing cancer cells, which depend on glutamine for survival. TFEB-driven glutaminase expression supports the metabolic flexibility that underlies therapy resistance. Pharmacological glutaminase inhibition sensitizes pancreatic tumor cells to chemotherapy and targeted agents.
context.zh-TW: 在胰腺癌中，TFEB 介導的 glutaminase 上調透過提供生長所需的麩醯胺衍生碳和氮，支持腫瘤代謝。麩醯胺分解是快速分裂癌細胞的標誌，它們依賴麩醯胺存活。TFEB 驅動的 glutaminase 表現支持構成治療抗性基礎的代謝靈活性。藥理學抑制 glutaminase 可使胰腺腫瘤細胞對化療和標靶藥物增敏。

context.en-US: The master autophagy-lysosomal regulator TFEB directly transactivates glutaminase (GLS and GLS2), coupling lysosomal-autophagy activation to glutamine catabolism. This transcriptional regulation supplies the carbon and nitrogen needed to support tumor metabolism in pancreatic cancer and other malignancies. TFEB-driven glutaminase upregulation supports the metabolic flexibility underlying therapy resistance. Thus glutaminase links amino acid metabolism to TFEB-driven transcription.
context.zh-TW: 自噬—溶酶體主調控因子 TFEB 直接轉錄活化 glutaminase（GLS 和 GLS2），將溶酶體—自噬活化與麩醯胺分解代謝耦合。此轉錄調節提供支持胰腺癌及其他惡性腫瘤代謝所需的碳和氮。TFEB 驅動的 glutaminase 上調支持構成治療抗性基礎的代謝靈活性。因此 glutaminase 將胺基酸代謝與 TFEB 驅動的轉錄連結起來。

context.en-US: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) phosphorylates TFEB at serines 134 and 138, residues that influence its subcellular localization and association with lysosomal membranes. These phosphorylations contribute to the regulated shuttling of TFEB and modulate its activity in response to Wnt and growth-factor signaling contexts. Because GSK3β activity is itself controlled by Akt and by nutrient state, this modification embeds TFEB within the broader insulin/PI3K signaling network. The sites complement the better-characterized S211 mark in fine-tuning TFEB localization.
context.zh-TW: 糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3β）於 serine 134 和 138 磷酸化 TFEB，這些殘基影響其亞細胞定位和與溶酶體膜的關聯。這些磷酸化有助於 TFEB 的調節性穿梭，並在 Wnt 和生長因子信號背景下調節其活性。由於 GSK3β 活性本身受 Akt 和營養狀態控制，此修飾將 TFEB 嵌入更廣泛的胰島素／PI3K 信號網絡。這些位點補充了特徵更清楚的 S211 標記，以微調 TFEB 定位。

context.en-US: HLH-30 prevents aging and extends lifespan in C. elegans; hlh-30 mutants are short-lived, and loss of hlh-30 suppresses the longevity conferred by mxl-3 deletion. By driving autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity embodies the conserved mechanism by which enhanced clearance promotes longevity across species. The epistasis with mxl-3 places HLH-30 downstream as the effector of the pro-longevity program.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中防止老化並延長壽命；hlh-30 突變體壽命短，且 hlh-30 的缺失抑制了 mxl-3 缺失所賦予的長壽。透過驅動自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性體現了增強清除能跨越物種促進長壽的保守機制。與 mxl-3 的遺傳上位性將 HLH-30 置於下游，作為促長壽程序的效應物。

context.en-US: HLH-30 regulates longevity in C. elegans, as its overexpression extends lifespan while loss of hlh-30 shortens it and suppresses the longevity of other mutants. By inducing autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity integrates insulin, mTOR, and dietary signals into a pro-longevity transcriptional program. The worm findings provide a conserved model for how TFEB orthologs promote healthspan in higher organisms.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中調節壽命，因為其過度表現可延長壽命，而 hlh-30 的缺失會縮短壽命並抑制其他突變體的長壽。透過誘發自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性將胰島素、mTOR 和飲食信號整合進促長壽的轉錄程序。線蟲的發現為 TFEB 同源物如何在高等生物中促進健康壽命提供了保守模型。

context.en-US: HLH-30, the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian TFEB, induces expression of the lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) in response to fasting, promoting mobilization of stored lipids. This transcriptional activation mirrors TFEB's induction of lipolytic and autophagic programs in mammals during nutrient scarcity. The HLH-30–lipase axis provides a molecular explanation for fasting-induced lipophagy and lifespan extension in worms. It demonstrates deep conservation of the MiT/TFE nutrient-response program.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 是哺乳動物 TFEB 在線蟲中的同源物，在回應禁食時誘發溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的表現，促進儲存脂質的動員。此轉錄活化反映了哺乳動物 TFEB 在營養匱乏時對脂解和自噬程序的誘發。HLH-30–脂肪酶軸為禁食誘發的脂噬和線蟲壽命延長提供了分子解釋。它展示了 MiT/TFE 營養反應程序的高度保守性。

context.en-US: HLH-30 translocates to and accumulates in intestinal nuclei of fasted C. elegans, where it activates the lysosomal, autophagic, and lipolytic transcriptional programs. This nuclear enrichment mirrors the starvation-induced nuclear entry of mammalian TFEB/TFE3 and is essential for the organism's adaptive response to food deprivation. The translocation is opposed by insulin/IGF and CeTOR signaling that retain HLH-30 cytoplasmically when food is available. Its nuclear localization thus serves as a key determinant of fasting-induced longevity.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 轉位至禁食線蟲的腸道細胞核中並在其中累積，於此活化溶酶體、自噬性和脂解性的轉錄程序。此核富集反映了哺乳動物 TFEB/TFE3 在飢餓誘發的核進入，並對生物適應食物剝奪的反應至為必要。此轉位受到胰島素/IGF 和 CeTOR 信號的拮抗，後者在食物可得時將 HLH-30 保留於細胞質。因此其核定位作為禁食誘發長壽的關鍵決定因子。

context.en-US: HLH-30 is required for survival during prolonged starvation; hlh-30 mutant animals die prematurely under nutrient-deprived conditions due to their inability to mount sufficient autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization. By activating the clearance and energy-mobilization programs, HLH-30 enables worms to withstand food absence. This essential role mirrors the dependence of mammalian cells on TFEB for stress resilience. The phenotype establishes HLH-30 as a critical effector of adaptive starvation responses.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 在長期飢餓期間的存活是必需的；hlh-30 突變動物在營養剝奪條件下過早死亡，因為它們無法啟動足夠的自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員。透過活化清除和能量動員程序，HLH-30 使線蟲能夠承受食物缺失。此必要角色反映了哺乳動物細胞對 TFEB 在壓力韌性上的依賴。該表型確立了 HLH-30 作為適應性飢餓反應的關鍵效應物。

context.en-US: Insulin signaling inhibits autophagy by activating the PI3K-Akt axis, which in turn activates mTORC1 and promotes phosphorylation of ULK1 and TFEB that suppress autophagic initiation and lysosomal gene expression. Through this cascade, the fed-state hormone maintains an anabolic, autophagy-off condition in peripheral tissues. The relief of insulin signaling during fasting or caloric restriction is therefore prerequisite for autophagic induction. This relationship is a primary reason why nutrient excess and insulin resistance are associated with impaired autophagy and metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: 胰島素信號透過活化 PI3K-Akt 軸來抑制自噬，後者接著活化 mTORC1 並促進 ULK1 和 TFEB 的磷酸化，從而抑制自噬起始和溶酶體基因表現。透過此級聯，進食狀態的荷爾蒙在周邊組織維持合成代謝、自噬關閉的條件。在禁食或熱量限制期間胰島素信號的解除，因此是誘發自噬的先決條件。此關係是營養過剩和胰島素抗性與自噬受損和代謝疾病相關的主要原因。

context.en-US: Intermittent fasting induces autophagy as an early cellular adaptation to the periodic nutrient and energy deficit it imposes. In vitro, fasting-mimetic conditions activate the autophagic machinery and concurrently downregulate the ectonucleotidase CD73, altering extracellular adenosine metabolism. The induction is largely mediated through AMPK activation and mTORC1 inhibition as nutrient and insulin signals fall during the fasting window. This autophagic engagement is thought to underlie many of the cytoprotective and anti-aging effects attributed to IF regimens.
context.zh-TW: 間歇性斷食誘導自噬，作為對其所施加的週期性營養和能量虧損的早期細胞適應。在體外，斷食模擬條件活化自噬機制並同時下調胞外核苷酸酶CD73，改變細胞外腺苷代謝。此誘導主要透過AMPK活化和mTORC1抑制介導，因為在斷食窗口期間營養和胰島素訊號下降。這種自噬的參與被認為是歸因於IF方案的許多細胞保護和抗老化效應的基礎。

context.en-US: Intermittent fasting lowers circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), a potent mitogenic and pro-survival hormone whose signaling converges on the PI3K-Akt-mTOR axis to inhibit autophagy. In a breast cancer model, a 48-hour fasting period reduced IGF-1 levels by approximately 70%, dampening pro-tumorigenic IGF-1 receptor signaling. The resulting reduction in mTORC1 activity contributes to the fasting-induced activation of autophagy and the enhanced stress resistance of normal tissues. Lower IGF-1 during fasting is therefore a key endocrine mechanism linking IF to both tumor suppression and longevity.
context.zh-TW: 間歇性斷食降低循環的類胰島素生長因子1（IGF-1），這是一種強效的促有絲分裂和促存活激素，其訊號匯聚於PI3K-Akt-mTOR軸以抑制自噬。在乳腺癌模型中，48小時斷食使IGF-1水平降低約70%，減弱促腫瘤生成的IGF-1受體訊號。由此產生的mTORC1活性降低有助於斷食誘導的自噬活化和正常組織增強的壓力抵抗。因此，斷食期間較低的IGF-1是將IF與腫瘤抑制和長壽連結的關鍵內分泌機制。

context.en-US: Ketogenic diets, characterized by high fat and very low carbohydrate intake, activate autophagy by lowering insulin and glucose while elevating ketone bodies and AMPK activity. The metabolic shift toward fatty-acid oxidation and mild energy stress mimics aspects of caloric restriction, engaging the autophagic machinery. This activation contributes to the reported healing and neuroprotective effects of ketogenic regimens in epilepsy, neurodegeneration, and metabolic disease. The diet thus provides a non-fasting nutritional strategy to recruit autophagic clearance.
context.zh-TW: 生酮飲食以高脂肪、極低碳水化合物攝取為特徵，透過降低胰島素和葡萄糖、同時升高酮體和 AMPK 活性來活化自噬。朝脂肪酸氧化和輕度能量壓力的代謝轉移模擬了熱量限制的某些層面，運用了自噬機械。此活化促成生酮飲食在癲癇、神經退化和代謝疾病中報告的修復和神經保護效應。因此此飲食提供了一種非禁食的營養策略，以招募自噬性清除。

context.en-US: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
context.zh-TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

context.en-US: LIPL-3 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that, like LIPL-1, co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2 and contributes to intralysosomal lipid hydrolysis. It is transcriptionally induced by HLH-30 under fasting conditions, enabling the breakdown of lipid droplets delivered via lipophagy. Together with other lipl family members, LIPL-3 is required for efficient energy mobilization during starvation. Its lysosomal localization anchors it within the autophagy-lysosomal degradative system.
context.zh-TW: LIPL-3 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，如同 LIPL-1，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，並有助於溶酶體內的脂質水解。它在禁食條件下受 HLH-30 轉錄誘發，使得經由脂噬遞送的脂滴得以分解。與其他 lipl 家族成員一起，LIPL-3 是飢餓期間有效能量動員所必需的。其溶酶體定位將它錨定於自噬—溶酶體降解系統中。

context.en-US: Lipophagy—the selective autophagic degradation of lipid droplets—is conserved across metazoans, as shown by the fact that inactivation of the autophagy genes lgg-1 and lgg-2 in C. elegans leads to increased fat accumulation. By delivering lipid droplets to lysosomes for lipase-mediated hydrolysis, lipophagy mobilizes stored energy during fasting. The conservation from worms to mammals indicates an ancient and essential role for autophagy in lipid homeostasis. Defective lipophagy contributes to hepatic steatosis and metabolic disease in higher organisms.
context.zh-TW: 脂噬——脂滴的選擇性自噬降解——在後生動物中保守，這由線蟲中自噬基因 lgg-1 和 lgg-2 的失活導致脂肪累積增加一事所證明。透過將脂滴遞送至溶酶體進行脂肪酶介導的水解，脂噬在禁食期間動員儲存的能量。從線蟲到哺乳動物的保守性表明，自噬在脂質恆定性中具有古老且必要的角色。缺陷的脂噬在高等生物中促成肝臟脂肪變性和代謝疾病。

context.en-US: Lysosome biogenesis is regulated by CDK4/6 such that inhibition of these kinases leads to nuclear retention of TFEB and enhanced expression of lysosomal genes. During active proliferation, CDK4/6-mediated phosphorylation of TFEB restrains lysosomal expansion; when CDK4/6 is blocked, the degradative network is unleashed. This regulation connects cell-cycle control to organelle homeostasis and may contribute to the metabolic effects of CDK4/6 inhibitors used in cancer therapy. It reveals lysosomal biogenesis as a cell-cycle-responsive process.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體生物發生受 CDK4/6 調節：抑制這些激酶會導致 TFEB 的核保留以及溶酶體基因表現增強。在活躍增殖期間，CDK4/6 介導的 TFEB 磷酸化約束溶酶體擴張；當 CDK4/6 被阻斷時，降解網絡隨之釋放。此調節將細胞週期控制連結到胞器恆定性，並可能促成用於癌症治療的 CDK4/6 抑制劑的代謝效應。它揭示溶酶體生物發生是一種對細胞週期有反應的過程。

context.en-US: The lysosome is the cell's terminal degradation center, containing acidic hydrolases that break down proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates delivered by endocytosis, phagocytosis, and autophagy. Beyond catabolism, lysosomes serve as signaling hubs that integrate nutrient and growth-factor inputs, most notably by hosting the activation of mTORC1 at their surface. This duality—as both waste-disposal organelle and metabolic command post—places lysosomes at the center of cellular homeostasis, development, and aging. Lysosomal dysfunction underlies a broad spectrum of storage and degenerative diseases.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體是細胞的終端降解中心，含有酸性水解酶，可分解經由胞吞作用、吞噬作用和自噬遞送的蛋白質、脂質、核酸和碳水化合物。除了分解代謝，溶酶體還作為整合營養和生長因子輸入的信號樞紐，最顯著者是在其表面主導 mTORC1 的活化。這種雙重性——既是廢物處理胞器也是代謝指揮站——使溶酶體位居細胞恆定性、發育與老化的中心。溶酶體功能失調是廣泛的儲存性和退化性疾病的基礎。

context.en-US: The lysosome serves as the physical platform for mTORC1 activation, hosting the recruitment of mTORC1 via Rag GTPases and Ragulator and its encounter with the activator Rheb at the lysosomal surface. Amino-acid sensing, growth-factor inputs, and calcium signals all converge at this organelle to determine mTORC1 activity. By colocalizing mTORC1 with its upstream regulators, the lysosome functionally couples nutrient detection to the control of autophagy and anabolism. This spatial organization is essential for the rapid, reversible regulation of the pathway.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體作為 mTORC1 活化的物理平台，主導 mTORC1 經由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 的招募，以及其與溶酶體表面活化劑 Rheb 的相遇。胺基酸感知、生長因子輸入和鈣信號都在此胞器匯聚以決定 mTORC1 活性。透過將 mTORC1 與其上游調節者共定位，溶酶體在功能上將營養偵測耦合到自噬和合成代謝的控制。此空間組織對途徑快速、可逆的調節至為必要。

context.en-US: MAP4K3 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 3, an N-terminal modification that primes TFEB for subsequent phosphorylation at S211 by mTORC1. This hierarchical phosphorylation reveals that TFEB regulation involves ordered, multi-site modification in which upstream kinases license downstream ones. By enabling the mTORC1 repressive mark, MAP4K3 integrates amino-acid and growth-factor inputs into TFEB control. The finding adds a further layer of complexity to the kinase network governing lysosomal gene transcription.
context.zh-TW: MAP4K3 於 serine 3 磷酸化 TFEB，這是一種使 TFEB 為後續 mTORC1 在 S211 的磷酸化做準備的 N 端修飾。這種階層性磷酸化顯示 TFEB 調節涉及有序的多位點修飾，其中上游激酶許可下游激酶。透過啟用 mTORC1 抑制性標記，MAP4K3 將胺基酸和生長因子輸入整合進 TFEB 控制中。此發現為控制溶酶體基因轉錄的激酶網絡增添了進一步的複雜層次。

context.en-US: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
context.zh-TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

subject: Metformin

context.en-US: Metformin, the first-line type 2 diabetes drug, activates AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) primarily by inhibiting mitochondrial respiratory complex I, which mildly elevates the cellular AMP/ATP ratio. Activated AMPK phosphorylates downstream targets that restore energy homeostasis, including TSC2 and Raptor, which in turn suppress mTORC1. This indirect, energy-stress-mediated activation distinguishes metformin from direct AMPK agonists and underlies many of its metabolic benefits. AMPK activation by metformin also accounts for its autophagy-inducing and potential anti-aging effects.
context.zh-TW: Metformin是一線第二型糖尿病藥物，主要透過抑制粒線體呼吸鏈複合體I來活化AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK），輕微提高細胞AMP/ATP比值。活化的AMPK磷酸化下游標靶以恢復能量穩態，包括TSC2和Raptor，後者進而抑制mTORC1。這種間接的、能量壓力介導的活化使metformin有別於直接的AMPK激動劑，並構成其許多代謝益處的基礎。Metformin對AMPK的活化也解釋了其誘導自噬和潛在抗老化的效應。

context.en-US: Metformin induces autophagy by activating AMPK and thereby inhibiting mTORC1, relieving the brake on the autophagic machinery. In primary CD4+ T cells isolated from older individuals, metformin treatment restored autophagic flux, suggesting a mechanism to counter age-associated immune dysfunction. The induction is consistent with the drug's broader metabolic and putative longevity effects mediated through energy-sensing pathways. By enhancing autophagic clearance, metformin may reduce senescence-associated inflammation and improve cellular resilience.
context.zh-TW: Metformin透過活化AMPK並從而抑制mTORC1來誘導自噬，解除對自噬機制的制動。在從老年人分離的原代CD4+ T細胞中，metformin治療恢復了自噬流，提示一種抵消與年齡相關免疫功能障碍的機制。此誘導與該藥物透過能量感知途徑發揮的更廣泛代謝和假定長壽效應一致。透過增強自噬清除，metformin可能減少衰老相關發炎並改善細胞韌性。

subject: Metformin

context.en-US: Metformin reverses the pro-inflammatory Th17 CD4+ T cell profile toward a more juvenile, balanced phenotype, an effect attributed to enhancement of autophagic flux within lymphocytes. By activating AMPK and inducing autophagy, metformin reduces the mitochondrial and metabolic perturbations that favor pathogenic Th17 differentiation. This phenotypic rebalancing may contribute to the drug's anti-inflammatory and immune-modulatory benefits beyond glycemic control. The observation links metformin's autophagy-inducing capacity to attenuation of age- and inflammation-associated T cell skewing.
context.zh-TW: Metformin 將促發炎的 Th17 CD4+ T 細胞譜系逆轉為更年輕、平衡的表型，此效應歸因於淋巴細胞內自噬流的增強。透過活化 AMPK 和誘導自噬，metformin 減少有利於致病性 Th17 分化的粒線體和代謝擾動。這種表型再平衡可能有助於該藥物超越血糖控制之外的抗發炎和免疫調節益處。此觀察將 metformin 誘導自噬的能力與減緩年齡和發炎相關的 T 細胞偏移聯繫起來。

context.en-US: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
context.zh-TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

context.en-US: Impaired mitophagy is a common feature of several neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and Huntington's disease. In these disorders, the accumulation of damaged mitochondria exacerbates oxidative stress, metabolic disruption, and neuronal death. Defects can arise from mutations in PINK1 or Parkin, from tau or amyloid-beta pathology, or from disrupted transport of autophagosomes. Restoring mitophagy is therefore a major therapeutic goal for neuroprotection.
context.zh-TW: Mitophagy 受損是多種神經退化性疾病的常見特徵，包括阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症、ALS 和亨丁頓氏症。在這些疾病中，受損粒線體的累積加劇氧化壓力、代謝紊亂和神經元死亡。缺陷可源於 PINK1 或 Parkin 突變、tau 或 amyloid-beta 病理，或自噬體運輸受擾。因此恢復 mitophagy 是神經保護的主要治療目標。

context.en-US: Mitophagy acts as a double-edged sword in neuronal survival. Insufficient clearance allows damaged mitochondria to accumulate, triggering inflammation and cell death, while excessive mitophagy depletes healthy mitochondria, causing bioenergetic failure. This bidirectional regulation means that both impairment and overactivation of mitophagy can precipitate neuronal damage. Striking the precise balance between removing dysfunctional and preserving healthy mitochondria is the central challenge for therapeutics.
context.zh-TW: Mitophagy 在神經元存活中扮演雙刃劍。清除不足使受損粒線體累積，觸發發炎和細胞死亡，而過度的 mitophagy 耗盡健康粒線體，造成生物能量衰竭。此雙向調節意味著 mitophagy 的受損和過度活化都可能引發神經元損傷。在移除功能失常與保留健康粒線體之間取得精確平衡是治療的核心挑戰。

context.en-US: Mitophagy is a specialized, evolutionarily conserved form of selective autophagy dedicated to the degradation of damaged or dysfunctional mitochondria. Under stress such as excessive ROS, nutrient deficiency, or cellular aging, mitochondria undergo depolarization and are selectively engulfed and eliminated. The process proceeds through recognition of damaged mitochondria, recruitment of adaptors or receptors, autophagosome formation, and fusion with lysosomes. This ensures mitochondrial quality control and cellular homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: Mitophagy 是選擇性自噬的一種特化、演化上保守的形式，專門降解受損或功能失常的粒線體。在過量 ROS、營養缺乏或細胞老化等壓力下，粒線體發生去極化並被選擇性吞噬和清除。此過程歷經辨識受損粒線體、招募接合蛋白或受體、自噬體形成，以及與溶酶體融合。這確保了粒線體品質控制和細胞恆定性。

context.en-US: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway integrates a wide array of intracellular and extracellular cues—including growth factors, insulin, amino acids, oxygen, and energy status—to coordinate cell growth, metabolism, proliferation, and survival. Through its two complexes, mTORC1 and mTORC2, it translates these inputs into decisions about biosynthesis versus catabolism, notably by inhibiting autophagy when resources are abundant. This central integrator role makes mTOR a nodal control point for physiology and a target for cancer, aging, and metabolic disease. Its dysregulation is implicated in nearly every major chronic disease.
context.zh-TW: 雷帕黴素機械性標靶（mTOR）途徑整合了廣泛的細胞內與細胞外線索——包括生長因子、胰島素、胺基酸、氧氣和能量狀態——以協調細胞生長、代謝、增殖與存活。透過其兩個複合物 mTORC1 和 mTORC2，它將這些輸入轉化為關於生物合成與分解代謝的決策，特別是在資源充裕時抑制自噬。這種核心整合者角色使 mTOR 成為生理學的節點控制點，以及癌症、老化和代謝疾病的標靶。其失調與幾乎每一種主要慢性疾病都有關聯。

context.en-US: mTORC1 is the master nutrient-sensitive repressor of autophagy, integrating signals from growth factors, amino acids, and energy to suppress the pathway when resources are abundant. Active mTORC1 phosphorylates ULK1 and Atg13, preventing initiation complex assembly, and phosphorylates TFEB/TFE3 to retain them in the cytosol, blocking lysosomal gene expression. Only when mTORC1 is inhibited—by starvation, AMPK, or rapamycin—does autophagy proceed. This inhibitory relationship places mTORC1 at the apex of autophagic control in mammalian cells.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1是mTOR通路中的主激酶，通常透過磷酸化Unc-51樣自噬啟動激酶1（ULK1）複合物的成分來抑制自噬。當雷帕霉素抑制mTORC1時，這種抑制被解除，自噬體形成啟動，激活降解蛋白質聚集物和受損細胞器的細胞回收過程。這種自噬抑制的解除是雷帕霉素提出的geroprotective機制的核心，維持蛋白質穩定並減少有絲分裂後細胞中的「毒性負擔」，但網路上抗衰老背景下從該通路得出的長壽聲稱並非基於正式的geroscience，缺乏精確的生物學...。

context.en-US: mTORC1 promotes lipid and cholesterol synthesis by activating the sterol regulatory element-binding proteins (SREBP1) and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), transcription factors that drive expression of lipogenic and adipogenic enzymes. This anabolic output supports membrane biogenesis and energy storage during growth. The lipid-synthetic program is coordinated with mTORC1's stimulation of protein and nucleotide synthesis to build cellular mass. Its dysregulation contributes to hepatic steatosis and metabolic syndrome.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 透過活化固醇調節元件結合蛋白（SREBP1）和過氧化物酶體增殖物活化受體 gamma（PPARγ）——驅動脂肪生成和成脂酵素表現的轉錄因子——來促進脂質和膽固醇合成。此合成代謝輸出在生長期間支持膜生物發生和能量儲存。脂質合成程序與 mTORC1 對蛋白質和核苷酸合成的刺激協調，以建構細胞質量。其失調促成肝臟脂肪變性和代謝症候群。

context.en-US: mTORC1 is recruited to the lysosomal surface, where it encounters its activator Rheb and receives upstream amino-acid and growth-factor inputs necessary for full activation. This spatial recruitment, mediated by Rag GTPases and the Ragulator scaffold, converts the lysosome into the signaling platform for mTORC1. Only when docked at the lysosome can mTORC1 efficiently phosphorylate its substrates, including TFEB and ULK1. Thus lysosomal localization is essential for mTORC1 function and for its inhibition of autophagy.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 被招募至溶酶體表面，在此它遇到其活化劑 Rheb，並接收上游胺基酸和生長因子輸入以達到完全活化。這種由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 支架介導的空間招募，將溶酶體轉化為 mTORC1 的信號平台。唯有停靠於溶酶體時，mTORC1 才能有效磷酸化其受質，包括 TFEB 和 ULK1。因此溶酶體定位對 mTORC1 功能及其對自噬的抑制至為關鍵。

context.en-US: mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) is composed of five core subunits: the catalytic kinase mTOR, the scaffold Raptor (which binds substrates and Rag GTPases), mLST8 (stabilizing the kinase domain), the inhibitory subunit PRAS40, and the negative regulator Deptor. This stoichiometric assembly defines mTORC1's substrate specificity and its sensitivity to upstream inputs such as amino acids and insulin. Raptor is essential for recruitment of mTORC1 to lysosomes and for phosphorylation of canonical substrates like S6K1 and 4E-BP1. The composition distinguishes mTORC1 from mTORC2, which shares mTOR, mLST8, and Deptor but includes Rictor instead of Raptor.
context.zh-TW: mTOR 複合物 1（mTORC1）由五個核心次單元組成：催化激酶 mTOR、支架蛋白 Raptor（結合受質和 Rag GTPases）、mLST8（穩定激酶結構域）、抑制性次單元 PRAS40，以及負向調節者 Deptor。此化學計量組裝決定了 mTORC1 的受質專一性及其對胺基酸和胰島素等上游輸入的敏感性。Raptor 對於將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體以及磷酸化 S6K1 和 4E-BP1 等典型受質至關重要。此組成將 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 區分開來，後者共享 mTOR、mLST8 和 Deptor，但包含 Rictor 而非 Raptor。

context.en-US: mTORC1 promotes cap-dependent protein synthesis by phosphorylating the eukaryotic initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 (4E-BP1), releasing eIF4E to initiate translation, and by phosphorylating S6 kinase 1 (S6K1), which enhances ribosome biogenesis and translational capacity. These outputs prioritize anabolic processes when nutrients and growth factors are plentiful. The stimulation of protein synthesis is a major consumer of cellular energy and amino acids, balanced against the catabolic program of autophagy. Dysregulated mTORC1-driven translation contributes to hypertrophy and malignancy.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 透過磷酸化真核起始因子 4E 結合蛋白 1（4E-BP1）促進帽依賴性蛋白質合成，釋放 eIF4E 以起始轉譯，並透過磷酸化 S6 激酶 1（S6K1）增強核醣體生物發生和轉譯能力。這些輸出在營養和生長因子充裕時優先安排合成代謝過程。蛋白質合成的刺激是細胞能量和胺基酸的主要消耗者，需與自噬的分解代謝程序取得平衡。失調的 mTORC1 驅動轉譯促成肥大和惡性腫瘤。

context.en-US: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFE3 at serine 321, an analog of the TFEB S211 site, thereby promoting cytosolic retention and inhibiting TFE3's transcriptional activity under nutrient-replete conditions. This parallel modification ensures that both MiT/TFE family master regulators are coordinately repressed by mTORC1. Upon starvation or mTORC1 inhibition, dephosphorylation permits TFE3 nuclear entry and activation of lysosomal genes. The conserved regulatory logic highlights the unified control of the degradative program.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 在 serine 321 磷酸化 TFE3，此位點是 TFEB S211 位點的類似物，從而在營養充足條件下促進細胞質保留並抑制 TFE3 的轉錄活性。此平行修飾確保 MiT/TFE 家族的兩個主調節者都被 mTORC1 協調抑制。在飢餓或 mTORC1 抑制時，去磷酸化允許 TFE3 核進入和溶酶體基因的活化。保守的調節邏輯凸顯了對降解程序的統一控制。

context.en-US: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 211 in the presence of nutrients and growth factors, creating a binding site for 14-3-3 proteins. This phosphorylation event is the principal mechanism by which mTORC1 retains TFEB in the cytosol and prevents its nuclear translocation under fed conditions. S211 phosphorylation thus links nutrient abundance directly to repression of the lysosomal-autophagic transcriptional program. Relief of this phosphorylation during starvation is required for TFEB to enter the nucleus and activate clearance genes.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 在營養和生長因子存在的情況下，於 serine 211 磷酸化 TFEB，創造出 14-3-3 蛋白的結合位點。此磷酸化事件是 mTORC1 在進食狀態下將 TFEB 保留於細胞質並阻止其核轉運的主要機制。因此 S211 磷酸化將營養豐裕直接連結到溶酶體—自噬轉錄程序的抑制。飢餓期間此磷酸化的解除是 TFEB 進入核內並活化清除基因所必需的。

context.en-US: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 122, an additional N-terminal regulatory site that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor under nutrient-rich conditions. Alongside S142 and S211, S122 forms part of the multi-site phosphorylation code through which mTORC1 enforces TFEB exclusion from the nucleus. Dephosphorylation of these sites by phosphatases such as PP2A is required for nuclear translocation. The multiplicity of mTORC1 sites provides tunable, robust control of lysosomal gene transcription.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 在 serine 122 磷酸化 TFEB，這是營養豐裕條件下促進該轉錄因子細胞質保留的額外 N 端調節位點。與 S142 和 S211 並列，S122 構成 mTORC1 用以將 TFEB 排除於核外之多位點磷酸化密碼的一部分。這些位點經 PP2A 等磷酸酶去磷酸化，是核轉運所必需的。mTORC1 多重位點的設計提供了對溶酶體基因轉錄可調、穩健的控制。

context.en-US: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 138, a residue also modified by GSK3β, and this phosphorylation promotes nuclear export of TFEB, complementing the cytosolic retention imposed at other sites. The accumulation of phosphates across the N-terminal regulatory region collectively suppresses TFEB transcriptional activity. Relief of S138 phosphorylation facilitates nuclear accumulation and activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program. This site therefore participates in the coordinated mTORC1 restraint of cellular clearance.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 在 serine 138 磷酸化 TFEB，此殘基亦受 GSK3β 修飾，此磷酸化促進 TFEB 的核輸出，補足其他位點施加的細胞質保留。N 端調節區磷酸根的增加共同抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。S138 磷酸化的解除有利於自噬—溶酶體程序的核累積與活化。因此此位點參與了 mTORC1 對細胞清除的協調性約束。

context.en-US: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at both serine 142 and serine 211, two residues whose combined modification enforces 14-3-3 binding and robust cytosolic retention of the transcription factor. These sites act synergistically to prevent TFEB nuclear entry and thus block activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program under nutrient-replete conditions. Dephosphorylation of both marks is required for full TFEB activation during starvation. The dual-site control exemplifies the redundancy mTORC1 employs to firmly suppress degradative transcription.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 在 serine 142 和 serine 211 兩處磷酸化 TFEB，這兩個殘基的聯合修飾強制了 14-3-3 結合以及該轉錄因子穩健的細胞質保留。這些位點協同作用以防止 TFEB 核進入，從而在營養充足條件下阻斷自噬—溶酶體程序的活化。飢餓期間必須將這兩個標記都去磷酸化，TFEB 才能完全活化。雙位點控制具體體現了 mTORC1 用以牢牢抑制降解轉錄的冗餘機制。

context.en-US: mTORC2 phosphorylates Akt at serine 473 within its hydrophobic motif, a modification required for full Akt catalytic activation alongside PDK1-mediated phosphorylation at Thr308. Active Akt then drives survival, growth, and mTORC1 activation, establishing an mTORC2-to-Akt-to-mTORC1 signaling cascade. This relationship makes mTORC2 an upstream regulator of the same anabolic and autophagy-suppressing programs executed by mTORC1. mTORC2's role in Akt activation is central to its pro-survival and metabolic functions.
context.zh-TW: mTORC2 在其疏水性基序內的 serine 473 磷酸化 Akt，此修飾與 PDK1 在 Thr308 的磷酸化共同為 Akt 催化活化所需。活化態的 Akt 隨後驅動存活、生長和 mTORC1 活化，建立起 mTORC2 至 Akt 至 mTORC1 的信號級聯。此關係使 mTORC2 成為由 mTORC1 執行的同一合成代謝與自噬抑制程序的上游調節者。mTORC2 在 Akt 活化中的角色對其促存活與代謝功能至關重要。

context.en-US: mTORC2, distinct from mTORC1, modulates chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) through effects on the lysosomal localization and function of the CMA receptor LAMP-2A. By influencing the spatial organization of lysosomal membranes, mTORC2 affects the capacity of lysosomes to import KFERQ-motif substrates via HSC70. This regulation reveals that both mTOR complexes impinge on lysosomal degradation, though via different substrates and mechanisms. The link expands the regulatory network controlling selective protein turnover during aging and disease.
context.zh-TW: mTORC2 不同於 mTORC1，透過影響 CMA 受體 LAMP-2A 的溶酶體定位和功能的效應，調節伴護蛋白介導的自噬（CMA）。透過影響溶酶體膜的空間組織，mTORC2 影響溶酶體經由 HSC70 輸入 KFERQ 基序受質的能力。此調節顯示兩個 mTOR 複合物都作用於溶酶體降解，儘管透過不同的受質和機制。此連結擴展了在老化和疾病中控制選擇性蛋白質更新的調節網絡。

context.en-US: mTORC2 regulates actin cytoskeleton organization and cell migration through phosphorylation of PKCα and via effects on paxillin, RhoA, and Rac1 signaling. These outputs control cell polarity, stress-fiber formation, and the ability of cells to remodel their architecture during growth and movement. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2's roles are more closely tied to spatial organization and survival than to bulk nutrient sensing. Dysregulation of mTORC2-dependent cytoskeletal control contributes to cancer cell invasion and metastasis.
context.zh-TW: mTORC2 透過磷酸化 PKCα 以及經由對 paxillin、RhoA 和 Rac1 信號的效應，調節肌動蛋白細胞骨架組織和細胞遷移。這些輸出控制了細胞極性、應力纖維形成，以及細胞在生長和移動期間重塑其架構的能力。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 的角色更密切地與空間組織和存活相關，而非大規模的營養感知。mTORC2 依賴的細胞骨架控制失調促成癌細胞侵襲和轉移。

subject: mTORC2
object: mTOR, Rictor, mSIN1, Protor-1, mLST8, Deptor

context.en-US: mTOR complex 2 (mTORC2) comprises six core proteins: mTOR, Rictor (its defining scaffold), mSIN1 (required for mTORC2 integrity and Akt phosphorylation), Protor-1, mLST8, and the negative regulator Deptor. mTORC2 is best known for phosphorylating and activating Akt at Ser473 and for regulating cytoskeletal organization and cell survival. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2 is not acutely rapamycin-sensitive and is not directly recruited to lysosomes by Rag GTPases. Its distinct composition underlies its separate physiological roles in metabolism and actin dynamics.
context.zh-TW: mTOR 複合物 2（mTORC2）包含六個核心蛋白：mTOR、Rictor（其定義性支架）、mSIN1（mTORC2 完整性與 Akt 磷酸化所需）、Protor-1、mLST8，以及負向調節者 Deptor。mTORC2 最為人所知的是在 Ser473 磷酸化並活化 Akt，以及調節細胞骨架組織和細胞存活。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 不會被雷帕黴素急性抑制，也不會被 Rag GTPases 直接招募至溶酶體。其獨特組成奠定了其在代謝和肌動蛋白動力學中各自獨立的生理角色。

context.en-US: MXL-3 promotes aging under abundant food conditions; worms lacking mxl-3 are long-lived, indicating that its repressive activity on lysosomal and lipolytic genes accelerates age-related decline. By maintaining a storage-oriented, low-autophagy state when nutrients are plentiful, MXL-3 limits the clearance and metabolic flexibility that promote longevity. This pro-aging effect is consistent with the broader principle that reduced nutrient signaling extends lifespan. The phenotype positions MXL-3 as a negative regulator of the pro-longevity degradative program.
context.zh-TW: MXL-3 在食物充裕的條件下促進老化；缺乏 mxl-3 的線蟲壽命較長，表明其對溶酶體和脂解基因的抑制性活性加速了與年齡相關的衰退。透過在營養豐富時維持以儲存為導向、低自噬的狀態，MXL-3 限制了促進長壽的清除和代謝靈活性。此促老化效應與「降低營養信號可延長壽命」的更廣泛原則一致。該表型將 MXL-3 定位為促長壽降解程序的負向調節者。

context.en-US: During fasting, MXL-3::GFP signal disappears from intestinal nuclei within about two hours, indicating that the repressor exits the nucleus and ceases to suppress its target genes. This delocalization is a rapid, nutrient-responsive event that permits de-repression of lysosomal lipase and autophagy genes. The nuclear export of MXL-3 complements the concurrent nuclear accumulation of HLH-30, creating a switch from storage to mobilization. The observation provides direct in vivo evidence for dynamic regulation of the lipid-degradation program.
context.zh-TW: 在禁食期間，MXL-3::GFP 訊號在大約兩小時內從腸道細胞核消失，表明該抑制因子離開細胞核並停止抑制其標的基因。此去定位是一個快速的、對營養有反應的事件，它允許溶酶體脂肪酶和自噬基因的解除抑制。MXL-3 的核輸出補充了同時發生的 HLH-30 核累積，創造出從儲存到動員的開關。此觀察為脂質降解程序的動態調節提供了直接的活體證據。

context.en-US: In C. elegans, the MAX-like transcription factor MXL-3 represses transcription of lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) when food is abundant, limiting lipid mobilization. This repression maintains lipid storage under fed conditions and is relieved during fasting, allowing lipolysis. MXL-3 thus acts as a nutritional gatekeeper of lysosomal lipid catabolism, analogous to MYC's repression of lysosomal programs in mammals. Its activity positions lipid degradation within the broader nutrient-responsive regulatory network.
context.zh-TW: 在線蟲 C. elegans 中，MAX 樣轉錄因子 MXL-3 在食物充裕時抑制溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的轉錄，限制脂質動員。此抑制在進食條件下維持脂質儲存，並在禁食期間解除，允許脂解作用。因此 MXL-3 作為溶酶體脂質分解代謝的營養閘門，類似於 MYC 在哺乳動物中對溶酶體程序的抑制。其活性將脂質降解定位於更廣泛的營養反應性調節網絡中。

context.en-US: MYC antagonizes TFEB and TFE3 transcriptional activities at lysosomal gene promoters, thereby repressing lysosome biogenesis in proliferating cells. Through direct competition for CLEAR elements and broader chromatin effects, MYC suppresses the degradative capacity that would otherwise constrain growth. This repression aligns cellular resources toward biosynthesis rather than turnover during oncogenic drive. The MYC-lysosome antagonism is a key axis by which cancer cells reshape their degradative landscape.
context.zh-TW: MYC 在溶酶體基因啟動子處拮抗 TFEB 和 TFE3 的轉錄活性，從而在增殖細胞中抑制溶酶體生物發生。透過對 CLEAR 元件的直接競爭以及更廣泛的染色質效應，MYC 抑制了本會限制生長的降解能力。此抑制將細胞資源在致癌驅動下導向生物合成而非更新。MYC-溶酶體拮抗作用是癌細胞重塑其降解景觀的關鍵軸。

context.en-US: The oncogenic transcription factor MYC competes with TFEB for binding to CLEAR elements in the promoters of lysosomal and autophagy genes. By occupying these sites, MYC represses the TFEB-driven transcriptional program while simultaneously driving its own proliferative gene network. This competitive binding creates a molecular antagonism between growth-promoting and degradative transcriptional programs. The interplay explains how MYC-high tumors suppress autophagy-lysosomal capacity even as they increase metabolic demand.
context.zh-TW: 致癌轉錄因子 MYC 與 TFEB 競爭結合溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件。透過佔據這些位點，MYC 抑制 TFEB 驅動的轉錄程序，同時驅動其自身的增生基因網絡。這種競爭性結合在促生長和降解的轉錄程序之間創造了分子拮抗。此交互作用解釋了 MYC 高表現的腫瘤如何抑制自噬—溶酶體能力，即使它們增加了代謝需求。

subject: P300

context.en-US: The acetyltransferase p300 acetylates ATG4B, an modification that inhibits its proteolytic activity required for LC3 lipidation and autophagosome formation, thereby restraining autophagy under normal conditions. This acetylation-dependent repression adds a transcriptional coactivator-derived control layer to core autophagy machinery beyond the well-studied phosphorylation circuits. Relief of p300-mediated acetylation during stress can de-repress ATG4B and facilitate autophagic flux. The finding situates autophagy regulation within the broader acetylome governed by p300/CBP.
context.zh-TW: 乙醯轉移酶 p300 乙醯化 ATG4B，此修飾抑制其為 LC3 脂化和自噬體形成所需的蛋白水解活性，從而在正常條件下約束自噬。此依賴乙醯化的抑制在眾所周知的磷酸化電路之外，為核心自噬機械增添了源自轉錄共活化因子的控制層次。在壓力期間 p300 媒介乙醯化的解除可解除 ATG4B 的抑制並促進自噬流。此發現將自噬調節置於 p300/CBP 所統轄的更廣泛乙醯體中。
