subject: p38 MAPK

context.en-US: p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB at serine 211, the same residue targeted by mTORC1, thereby promoting cytoplasmic retention under certain stress conditions. This convergence indicates that both growth-factor (mTORC1) and stress (p38) signaling can independently restrain TFEB nuclear entry. The p38-mediated phosphorylation underscores the role of stress-activated MAPK pathways in modulating degradative transcription. Context determines whether p38 signaling suppresses or, at other sites, activates TFEB.
context.zh-TW: p38 MAPK 於 serine 211 磷酸化 TFEB，此為 mTORC1 標靶的相同殘基，從而在某些壓力條件下促進細胞質保留。此匯聚顯示生長因子（mTORC1）和壓力（p38）信號都能獨立地約束 TFEB 核進入。p38 介導的磷酸化強調了壓力活化的 MAPK 途徑在調節降解轉錄中的作用。脈絡決定 p38 信號是抑制還是在其他位點活化 TFEB。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: p38 MAPK

context.en-US: In contrast to its S211 effect, p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB at serine 401 in a manner that promotes nuclear translocation in specific cell types such as monocytes. This site-specific divergence illustrates that p38 can either retain or activate TFEB depending on cell context and the constellation of concurrent modifications. Such opposing outcomes highlight the combinatorial code by which multiple phosphorylations determine TFEB localization. The monocyte-specific response implicates TFEB in immune cell activation and inflammatory programs.
context.zh-TW: 相對於其 S211 效應，p38 MAPK 以促進核轉運的方式於 serine 401 磷酸化 TFEB，此作用發生在特定細胞類型如單核細胞中。這種位點特異性分歧說明 p38 可根據細胞背景和同時存在的修飾組合，保留或活化 TFEB。這種相反結果凸顯了多種磷酸化決定 TFEB 定位的組合密碼。單核細胞特異性反應將 TFEB 牽涉進免疫細胞活化和發炎程序。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

context.en-US: Parkin is an E3 ubiquitin ligase that, once activated by PINK1, ubiquitinates outer mitochondrial membrane proteins such as MFN1, MFN2, and Miro1. This ubiquitination tags the damaged mitochondrion for autophagic clearance and prevents re-fusion with the healthy network. Autophagy receptors such as p62, NDP52, and OPTN recognize the ubiquitin chains as eat-me signals. Parkin-mediated mitophagy is a central quality-control mechanism, and its failure underlies familial Parkinson's disease.
context.zh-TW: Parkin 是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，一旦被 PINK1 活化，即泛素化粒線體外膜蛋白如 MFN1、MFN2 和 Miro1。此泛素化將受損粒線體標記以供自噬清除，並防止其與健康網絡重新融合。p62、NDP52 和 OPTN 等自噬受體辨識泛素鏈作為『吃掉我』訊號。Parkin 介導的 mitophagy 是核心品質控制機制，其失敗是家族性帕金森氏症的基礎。

context.en-US: Programmed cell death protein 4 (PDCD4) suppresses TFEB translation by binding eukaryotic initiation factor 4A (eIF4A) and inhibiting the RNA helicase activity required for ribosome scanning of the TFEB mRNA. This translational blockade limits TFEB protein synthesis independently of its transcriptional or degradative regulation. PDCD4 thereby acts as a brake on the autophagy-lysosomal program at the level of protein synthesis. Its own downregulation in cancer may contribute to the elevated TFEB activity observed in some malignancies.
context.zh-TW: 細胞程序性死亡蛋白 4（PDCD4）透過結合真核起始因子 4A（eIF4A）並抑制 TFEB mRNA 核糖體掃描所需的 RNA 解旋酶活性，抑制 TFEB 轉錄。此轉錄阻斷獨立於其轉錄或降解調節而限制 TFEB 蛋白合成。PDCD4 因此在蛋白質合成層次上充當自噬—溶酶體程序的制動。其在癌症中的自身下調可能促成某些惡性腫瘤中觀察到的 TFEB 活性升高。

context.en-US: PERO1 functions as a sensor of oleic acid accumulation on damaged peroxisomes, triggering autophagic removal of these defective organelles. By detecting lipid imbalance indicative of peroxisomal dysfunction, PERO1 initiates quality-control degradation that prevents the propagation of impaired organelles. This lipid-sensing mechanism links metabolic state to organelle surveillance. The pathway exemplifies how selective autophagy integrates metabolic cues to maintain peroxisome integrity.
context.zh-TW: PERO1 作為受損過氧化體上油酸累積的感測器，觸發對這些缺陷胞器的自噬性移除。透過偵測指示過氧化體功能障礙的脂質失衡，PERO1 啟動品質控制降解，防止受損胞器的傳播。此脂質感測機制將代謝狀態與胞器監控連結起來。此途徑具體體現了選擇性自噬如何整合代謝線索以維持過氧化體完整性。

context.en-US: Peroxisomes are the primary site where very long chain fatty acids are shortened into shorter-chain products such as acetyl-CoA that can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation. Impaired peroxisomal beta-oxidation causes toxic VLCFA accumulation, the hallmark of Zellweger syndrome and adrenoleukodystrophy.
context.zh-TW: Peroxisome 是極長鏈脂肪酸進行縮短代謝的主要場所，產物如 acetyl-CoA 可進入粒線體完成氧化。過氧化物體 beta-oxidation 功能受損會導致有毒的 VLCFA 累積，這是 Zellweger syndrome 與 adrenoleukodystrophy 的標誌性特徵。

context.en-US: The peroxisome biogenesis network receives material from autophagy when damaged peroxisomes are engulfed and fragmented, generating precursors that can be reassembled into functional peroxisomes. This autophagic-lysosomal processing of peroxisomal components allows recycling of membrane and matrix constituents to support new organelle formation. The relationship couples selective peroxisome degradation (pexophagy) to organelle turnover and renewal. It highlights autophagy's role not only in disposal but also in enabling peroxisome homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: 過氧化體生物發生網絡在受損過氧化體被吞噬和碎裂時從自噬接收物質，產生可被重新組裝成功能性過氧化體的前驅物。這種過氧化體組分的自噬—溶酶體處理允許膜和基質成分的回收，以支持新胞器的形成。此關係將選擇性過氧化體降解（pexophagy）與胞器週轉和更新耦合起來。它凸顯了自噬的角色不僅在於處置，也在於促成過氧化體恆定性。

context.en-US: The Peroxisome Biogenesis Network (PBN), a dynamic pool of pre-peroxisomal precursors residing in the cytosol, receives lipids and membrane material from the endoplasmic reticulum through direct ER-PBN contact sites. Pre-peroxisomal vesicles bud from the ER membrane and mature by importing peroxisomal proteins and lipids.
context.zh-TW: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network（PBN，位於細胞質的前過氧化物體前驅池）透過直接的 ER-PBN 接觸位点，自內質網獲得脂質與膜物質。前過氧化物體囊泡自內質網膜出芽，並藉由輸入過氧化物體蛋白與脂質而成熟。

context.en-US: PEX1 is an ATPase essential for peroxisome membrane assembly and matrix protein import, operating as part of the peroxisomal AAA (ATPases associated with diverse cellular activities) machinery. Loss of PEX1 causes a complete lack of functional peroxisomes, as import and biogenesis cannot proceed. This essential role makes PEX1 mutations among the most common causes of peroxisome biogenesis disorders. The gene thus sits at the foundation of peroxisome formation and metabolic competence.
context.zh-TW: PEX1 是一種對過氧化體膜組裝和基質蛋白輸入至關必要的 ATPase，作為過氧化體 AAA（與多樣細胞活動相關的 ATPase）機械的一部分運作。PEX1 的缺失導致功能性過氧化體完全缺乏，因為輸入和生物發生無法進行。此必要角色使 PEX1 突變成為過氧化體生物發生障礙最常見的原因。因此該基因位居過氧化體形成和代謝能力的基礎。

context.en-US: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
context.zh-TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

context.en-US: The class III phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K III) complex, centered on Vps34 and including Beclin 1, Atg14, Vps15, and Ambra-1, generates phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) at membranes to drive autophagosome nucleation. PI3P recruits effector proteins carrying PI3P-binding domains that organize the expanding phagophore and tether downstream ATG conjugation systems. Beclin 1 is a tumor suppressor whose activity is modulated by interacting partners and by anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins that restrain autophagy under fed conditions. This nucleation complex functions immediately downstream of the ULK1 initiator and is a critical control node for the magnitude of autophagic responses.
context.zh-TW: 第三類磷脂醯肌醇3-激酶（PI3K III）複合體以Vps34為核心，並包含Beclin 1、Atg14、Vps15和Ambra-1，在膜上生成磷脂醯肌醇3-磷酸（PI3P）以驅動自噬體成核。PI3P招募帶有PI3P結合域的效應蛋白，這些蛋白組織擴展中的吞噬泡並繫留下游的ATG共軛系統。Beclin 1是一種腫瘤抑制因子，其活性受交互作用夥伴以及抗凋亡Bcl-2家族蛋白的調節，後者在進食狀態下抑制自噬。此成核複合體作用於ULK1起始者緊接的下游，是自噬反應強度的關鍵控制節點。

context.en-US: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide kinase that converts phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) into phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PI(3,5)P2) on endolysosomal membranes. PI(3,5)P2 serves as a crucial lipid messenger that regulates membrane trafficking, vacuole homeostasis, and the activity of the lysosomal channel TRPML1. By generating PI(3,5)P2, PIKfyve controls lysosomal morphology and the calcium release that activates calcineurin-TFEB signaling. Its inhibition causes massive lysosomal vacuolation, underscoring its centrality to lysosomal function.
context.zh-TW: PIKfyve 是一種磷酸肌醇激酶，在內溶酶體膜上將磷脂醯肌醇 3-磷酸（PI3P）轉化為磷脂醯肌醇 3,5-二磷酸（PI(3,5)P2）。PI(3,5)P2 作為一種關鍵的脂質信使，調節膜運輸、液泡恆定性，以及溶酶體通道 TRPML1 的活性。透過生成 PI(3,5)P2，PIKfyve 控制溶酶體形態以及活化 calcineurin-TFEB 信號的鈣釋放。其抑制會導致大規模溶酶體液泡化，凸顯其對溶酶體功能的核心地位。

context.en-US: PINK1 is a mitochondrial damage sensor that stabilizes on the outer mitochondrial membrane upon loss of membrane potential, where it recruits and phosphorylates the cytosolic E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin. This phosphorylation activates Parkin and targets it to damaged mitochondria, where it ubiquitinates outer membrane proteins. The recruitment is facilitated by the scaffolding protein FBXO7. PINK1 therefore acts upstream of Parkin to initiate ubiquitin-dependent mitophagy.
context.zh-TW: PINK1 是粒線體損傷感測器，在膜電位喪失時穩定於粒線體外膜上，於此招募並磷酸化細胞質 E3 泛素連接酶 Parkin。此磷酸化活化 Parkin 並將其標靶至受損粒線體，於此泛素化外膜蛋白。此招募由支架蛋白 FBXO7 促進。因此 PINK1 作用於 Parkin 上游，啟動依賴泛素的 mitophagy。

context.en-US: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
context.zh-TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

context.en-US: Protein kinase C beta (PKCβ) phosphorylates TFEB at a cluster of C-terminal serines (461, 462, 466, 468), modifications that promote TFEB stability rather than suppressing it. Enhanced stability increases the available pool of TFEB that can be activated when nuclear entry is permitted. This contrasts with the predominantly inhibitory phosphorylations at N-terminal mTORC1 sites, illustrating that C-terminal modifications can be activatory. The PKCβ-TFEB relationship adds nuance to the site-specific regulatory code governing the transcription factor.
context.zh-TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCβ）在 C 端絲胺酸簇（461、462、466、468）磷酸化 TFEB，這些修飾促進 TFEB 穩定性而非抑制它。增強的穩定性增加了在核進入被許可時可被活化的 TFEB 可用庫。這與 N 端 mTORC1 位點主要為抑制性磷酸化形成對比，說明 C 端修飾可以是活化性的。PKCβ-TFEB 關係為控制該轉錄因子的位點特異性調節密碼增添了細微差別。

subject: PP2A

context.en-US: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) dephosphorylates TFEB at serines 122, 109, and 114, removing repressive mTORC1 and other kinase marks to permit TFEB nuclear translocation. By counteracting the multiple N-terminal phosphorylations that enforce cytosolic retention, PP2A acts as a key permissive switch for TFEB activation. Its activity is regulated by nutrient state and by regulatory subunits that target it to TFEB. Through this dephosphorylation, PP2A enables the rapid engagement of lysosomal biogenesis when mTORC1 is inhibited.
context.zh-TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）在 serine 122、109 和 114 去磷酸化 TFEB，移除抑制性的 mTORC1 及其他激酶標記，以許可 TFEB 核轉運。透過對抗強制細胞質保留的多重 N 端磷酸化，PP2A 充當 TFEB 活化的關鍵許可開關。其活性受營養狀態以及將其標靶至 TFEB 的調節次單元所控制。透過此去磷酸化，PP2A 使得在 mTORC1 受抑制時能快速啟動溶酶體生物發生。

context.en-US: PRAS40 is an mTORC1-associated protein that acts as a negative regulator by competing for substrate binding and limiting mTORC1 kinase activity, particularly when the complex is in a low-activity state. Growth-factor signaling through Akt phosphorylates PRAS40, releasing its inhibition and permitting mTORC1 activation. Thus PRAS40 provides a built-in brake that is relieved by anabolic signals. Its dynamic association fine-tunes mTORC1 output in response to the cellular environment.
context.zh-TW: PRAS40 是一種與 mTORC1 相關的蛋白質，作為負向調節者，透過競爭受質結合並限制 mTORC1 激酶活性——尤其是在複合物處於低活性狀態時。透過 Akt 的生長因子信號磷酸化 PRAS40，釋放其抑制並允許 mTORC1 活化。因此 PRAS40 提供了一個由合成代謝信號解除的內建制動。其動態聯合依據細胞環境精細調諧 mTORC1 輸出。

context.en-US: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation, positioning mTORC1 for activation; amino-acid starvation inactivates Rags and disperses mTORC1, de-repressing autophagy. The Rags therefore act as amino-acid sensors that bridge nutrient availability to mTORC1 spatial activation. Their regulation by the Ragulator and GAPs (e.g., GATOR complexes) is central to nutrient signaling.
context.zh-TW: Rag GTPases（RagA/B 和 RagC/D）作為異二聚體發揮功能，結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重新定位至活化劑 Rheb 所在的溶酶體表面。胺基酸充足有利於活化的 Rag 構象，將 mTORC1 定位以進行活化；胺基酸飢餓則使 Rags 失活並分散 mTORC1，解除對自噬的抑制。因此 Rags 作為胺基酸感測器，將營養可得性橋接到 mTORC1 的空間活化。它們受 Ragulator 和 GAPs（例如 GATOR 複合物）調節，是營養信號的核心。

context.en-US: The Ragulator is a multiprotein scaffold anchored at the lysosomal membrane that interacts with Rag GTPases to recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acids. By tethering the Rag-mTORC1 complex at the lysosome, Ragulator enables amino-acid sensing to converge with Rheb-mediated activation. Loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. The complex is therefore the lynchpin coupling lysosomal amino-acid detection to mTORC1 and autophagy control.
context.zh-TW: Ragulator 是錨定於溶酶體膜上的多蛋白支架，與 Rag GTPases 交互作用，以回應胺基酸將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體表面。透過將 Rag-mTORC1 複合物栓繫於溶酶體，Ragulator 使得胺基酸感知能與 Rheb 介導的活化匯聚。Ragulator 的缺失會破壞依賴營養的 mTORC1 信號並解除對自噬的抑制。因此該複合物是將溶酶體胺基酸偵測連結至 mTORC1 與自噬控制的關鍵樞紐。

context.en-US: Rapamycin delays immune aging by inhibiting mTORC1, an intervention shown to restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance the generation and persistence of memory CD8+ T cells in aged subjects. Mechanistically, mTORC1 inhibition shifts lymphocytes toward a more naïve, less exhausted state and promotes autophagy-mediated quality control within immune cells. In preclinical and clinical studies, transient rapamycin treatment improved immune responses to vaccination in the elderly. These effects illustrate how targeting the mTOR-autophagy axis can functionally rejuvenate the aging immune system.
context.zh-TW: Rapamycin透過抑制mTORC1來延緩免疫老化，此介入已被證明可恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強老年個體中記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成與持續。在機制上，mTORC1抑制將淋巴細胞推向更初始、較不耗竭的狀態，並促進免疫細胞內自噬介導的品質控制。在臨床前和臨床研究中，短暫的rapamycin治療改善了老年人對疫苗的免疫反應。這些效應說明了標靶mTOR—自噬軸如何能在功能上使老化的免疫系統恢復年輕。

context.en-US: Rapamycin is a potent allosteric inhibitor of mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1), binding the intracellular immunophilin FKBP12 to form a complex that occludes the mTORC1 active site. By inhibiting mTORC1, rapamycin relieves the constitutive repression of the ULK1 complex and of TFEB/TFE3, thereby inducing autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis. Its specificity for mTORC1 (with weaker, delayed effects on mTORC2) makes it a canonical tool for dissecting nutrient-signaling pathways. Rapamycin and its analogs are foundational longevity and immunosuppressive agents whose benefits are largely attributed to mTORC1 inhibition.
context.zh-TW: Rapamycin，1970年代從復活節島（Rapanui）的吸水鏈黴菌中發現的抗生素，抑制mTORC1，這是mTOR途徑中的主激酶，調節細胞生長、蛋白質合成和代謝。透過抑制mTORC1，rapamycin模擬由熱量限制實現的營養稀缺的生物化學，將細胞活性從合成代謝過程轉向維護和修復途徑，促進自噬和改善蛋白質恆定性。mTORC1活性隨年齡增長而增加，導致年齡相關病理，因此其理論上可以減緩老化。

context.en-US: Oncogenic RAS signaling drives a metabolic reprogramming in which transformed cells upregulate basal autophagy to supply the amino acids, lipids, and nucleotides needed for sustained proliferation. Mutant RAS activates both mTOR and, via nutrient and energy stress feedback, the autophagic machinery, allowing tumor cells to survive in nutrient-poor microenvironments. Pharmacologic or genetic blockade of autophagy selectively impairs the viability of RAS-driven tumors, highlighting autophagy as a dependency in these cancers. This dependency has motivated clinical efforts to combine RAS pathway-targeted or standard therapies with autophagy inhibition.
context.zh-TW: 致癌性RAS訊號驅動一種代謝重編程，其中轉化細胞上調基礎自噬以供应持續增殖所需的胺基酸、脂質和核苷酸。突變RAS同時活化mTOR，並透過營養和能量壓力回饋活化自噬機制，使腫瘤細胞能在營養貧乏的微環境中存活。藥理或遺傳性阻斷自噬會選擇性地損害RAS驅動腫瘤的存活能力，凸顯自噬在這些癌症中的依賴性。此依賴性推動了將RAS路徑標靶或標準療法與自噬抑制相結合的臨床努力。

context.en-US: REDD1 (regulated in development and DNA damage responses 1) inhibits mTORC1 specifically under hypoxia by binding and releasing TSC2 from inhibitory 14-3-3 association, thereby activating the TSC GAP complex. This allows Rheb to be converted to its inactive GDP form and mTORC1 to be suppressed, conserving energy when oxygen is limiting. REDD1 thus provides a hypoxia-responsive brake that engages autophagy and limits anabolic consumption. Its induction is transcriptionally controlled by HIF-1α, integrating oxygen sensing with mTORC1 regulation.
context.zh-TW: REDD1（發育與 DNA 損傷反應中受調節者 1）在缺氧條件下特異性地抑制 mTORC1，透過結合並將 TSC2 從抑制性的 14-3-3 聯合中釋放出來，從而活化 TSC GAP 複合物。這使得 Rheb 被轉化為其失活的 GDP 形式，mTORC1 被抑制，以在氧氣受限時節省能量。因此 REDD1 提供了一個對缺氧有反應的制動，啟動自噬並限制合成代謝消耗。它的誘發受 HIF-1α 轉錄控制，將氧氣感知與 mTORC1 調節整合起來。

context.en-US: Rheb (Ras homolog enriched in brain) is a small GTPase that directly binds and activates mTORC1 when in its GTP-bound state, provided mTORC1 is localized at the lysosomal surface. Rheb's activity is held in check by the TSC1/TSC2 GAP complex, making it the immediate effector that relays growth and nutrient signals to mTORC1. GTP-Rheb relieves the autoinhibitory conformation of mTORC1, enabling substrate phosphorylation. As the proximal activator, Rheb sits at the convergence point of multiple upstream inhibitory pathways.
context.zh-TW: Rheb（腦部富集的 Ras 同源物）是一種小 GTPase，在其 GTP 結合態時直接結合並活化 mTORC1，前提是 mTORC1 定位於溶酶體表面。Rheb 的活性受 TSC1/TSC2 GAP 複合物控制，使其成為將生長和營養信號傳遞至 mTORC1 的立即效應物。GTP-Rheb 解除 mTORC1 的自抑構象，使其能磷酸化受質。作為近端活化劑，Rheb 位於多條上游抑制途徑的匯聚點。

context.en-US: Selective autophagy targets damaged peroxisomes for degradation through a process termed pexophagy, in which ubiquitin tagging of peroxisomal proteins and recruitment of ESCRT (endosomal sorting complex required for transport) machinery mark the organelle for autophagic engulfment. This cargo-specific pathway contrasts with bulk autophagy by requiring receptor proteins that bridge the peroxisome to the autophagosomal membrane. Pexophagy protects cells from the oxidative and metabolic damage caused by defective peroxisomes. Its failure leads to accumulation of aberrant organelles and disease.
context.zh-TW: 選擇性自噬透過稱為 pexophagy 的過程，標靶受損過氧化體進行降解，其中過氧化體蛋白的泛素標記和 ESCRT（運輸所需內體分選複合物）機制的招募，將該胞器標定為自噬吞噬。此貨物特異性途徑不同於整體自噬之處，在於它需要受體蛋白將過氧化體橋接到自噬體膜。Pexophagy 保護細胞免於缺陷過氧化體造成的氧化和代謝損傷。其失敗導致異常胞器與疾病的累積。

context.en-US: Damaged or dysfunctional peroxisomes are selectively targeted for autophagic degradation: they are tagged with specific ubiquitin chains (notably Lys48-linked), recognized by autophagic machinery including LC3-interacting proteins and ESCRT components, sealed into autophagosomes, and delivered to lysosomes for breakdown and recycling. This continuous turnover maintains a healthy peroxisome pool.
context.zh-TW: 受損或功能失常的過氧化物體會被選擇性地標記以進行自噬降解：先被特定泛素鏈（尤其是 Lys48 鏈）標記，再由含 LC3 交互作用蛋白與 ESCRT 成分的自噬機制辨識，包入自噬體後送至溶酶體分解回收。此持續週轉維持了健康的過氧化物體儲備。

context.en-US: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the ensemble of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and matrix-remodeling enzymes secreted by senescent cells. Accumulation of senescent cells with age creates a chronic, low-grade inflammatory milieu that drives inflammaging—the sterile inflammation implicated in nearly all age-related diseases. SASP factors recruit immune cells, promote fibrosis, and induce paracrine senescence in neighboring cells, establishing feed-forward tissue deterioration. Targeting senescent cells or their SASP is a major therapeutic avenue to reduce inflammaging.
context.zh-TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子和基質重塑酵素之集合。衰老細胞隨年齡累積，創造出慢性、低度的發炎環境，驅動 inflammaging——一種與幾乎所有與年齡相關疾病有關的無菌性發炎。SASP 因子招募免疫細胞、促進纖維化，並誘發鄰近細胞的旁分泌性衰老，建立前饋式的組織惡化。標靶衰老細胞或其 SASP 是減少 inflammaging 的一個主要治療途徑。

context.en-US: SIRT1, a NAD+-dependent class III deacetylase, deacetylates TFEB at lysine 116, an event that enhances TFEB nuclear translocation and transcriptional activity. Because SIRT1 activity rises during caloric restriction and exercise when cellular NAD+ is elevated, this deacetylation couples energy status to activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program. Deacetylation at K116 therefore complements phosphorylation-mediated control and reinforces TFEB function under pro-longevity conditions. The SIRT1-TFEB axis is a key molecular explanation for the autophagic benefits of NAD+-boosting interventions.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 是一種 NAD+ 依賴型 III 類去乙醯酶，於 lysine 116 去乙醯化 TFEB，此事件增強 TFEB 核轉運和轉錄活性。由於 SIRT1 活性在熱量限制和運動期間、當細胞 NAD+ 升高時上升，此去乙醯化將能量狀態耦合到自噬—溶酶體程序的活化。K116 的去乙醯化因此補充了磷酸化介導的控制，並在促長壽條件下強化 TFEB 功能。SIRT1-TFEB 軸是 NAD+ 提升介入之自噬益處的一個關鍵分子解釋。

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2, a cytosolic NAD+-dependent deacetylase, deacetylates ATG4B in response to starvation, modulating the activity of this cysteine protease that processes and delipidates the autophagosome marker LC3/GABARAP. Deacetylation of ATG4B influences the dynamics of LC3 conjugation and autophagosome maturation, fine-tuning autophagic flux. Because SIRT2 activity rises when NAD+ is elevated during CR and exercise, this modification links energy status to autophagosome biogenesis. The SIRT2-ATG4B axis adds an acetylation layer to core autophagy machinery regulation.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 是一種胞質 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯酶，在回應飢餓時去乙醯化 ATG4B——該半胱氨酸蛋白酶負責處理並去脂化自噬體標記 LC3/GABARAP。ATG4B 的去乙醯化影響 LC3 共軛和自噬體成熟的動力學，精細調諧自噬流。由於 SIRT2 活性在熱量限制和運動期間 NAD+ 升高時上升，此修飾將能量狀態與自噬體生物發生連結起來。SIRT2-ATG4B 軸為核心自噬機械的調節增添了乙醯化層次。

context.en-US: SLC-36.1 (a solute carrier) forms a complex with the PPK-3/PIKfyve kinase module to regulate phagocytic lysosome reformation (PLR), the process by which phagolysosomes regenerate new lysosomes after phagocytosis. By influencing PI(3,5)P2 generation and membrane dynamics, this complex ensures restoration of the lysosomal pool following immune or clearance challenges. Defects in PLR impair the ability of phagocytes to sustain repeated rounds of degradation. The pathway connects solute transport and phosphoinositide metabolism to innate immune function.
context.zh-TW: SLC-36.1（一種溶質載體）與 PPK-3/PIKfyve 激酶模組形成複合物，以調節吞噬性溶酶體重組（PLR）——即吞噬溶酶體在吞噬作用後再生新溶酶體的過程。透過影響 PI(3,5)P2 生成和膜動力學，此複合物確保在免疫或清除挑戰後溶酶體庫的恢復。PLR 的缺陷會損害吞噬細胞持續多輪降解的能力。此途徑將溶質運輸和磷酸肌醇代謝連結到先天免疫功能。

context.en-US: Spermidine reverses features of arterial aging, including large elastic artery stiffening, and restores nitric-oxide-mediated endothelial function in aged vessels. These vascular benefits are linked to spermidine-induced autophagy, which clears damaged mitochondria and reduces vascular oxidative stress and inflammation. By improving endothelial-dependent vasodilation, spermidine counteracts the stiffening that drives systolic hypertension and cardiovascular risk with age. The findings support spermidine as a candidate intervention for vascular rejuvenation.
context.zh-TW: 精胺逆轉動脈老化的特徵，包括大彈性動脈僵硬化，並恢復老化血管中一氧化氮介導的內皮功能。這些血管益處與精胺誘發的自噬相關，後者清除受損粒線體並減少血管氧化壓力和發炎。透過改善內皮依賴性血管舒張，精胺抵消了隨年齡驅動收縮期高血壓和心血管風險的僵硬化。這些發現支持精胺作為血管回春的候選介入。

context.en-US: Spermidine is a naturally occurring polyamine with conserved anti-aging properties that acts as a potent inducer of autophagy across organisms from yeast to humans. It promotes autophagy through multiple mechanisms, including enhancement of histone H3 deacetylation and, via hypusination of eIF5A, facilitation of TFEB translation and lysosomal gene expression. Dietary spermidine supplementation extends lifespan and protects against cardiovascular and cognitive decline in preclinical models. Its ability to engage the autophagy-lysosomal network safely makes it a leading caloric-restriction mimetic candidate.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine是一種天然存在、具有保守抗老化特性的多胺，作為從酵母到人類各生物中強效的自噬誘導劑。它透過多種機制促進自噬，包括增強組蛋白H3去乙醯化和透過eIF5A的hypusination促進TFEB轉譯及溶酶體基因表現。飲食補充spermidine在臨床前模型中延長壽命並保護免受心血管和認知衰退。其安全參與自噬—溶酶體網絡的能力，使其成為領先的熱量限制擬似物候選者。

context.en-US: Spermidine enhances autophagy through multiple complementary mechanisms, prominently including induction of histone H3 deacetylation that relaxes chromatin at autophagy gene loci and promotes their transcription. It additionally supports autophagy via hypusination-dependent translation of TFEB and direct effects on the autophagic machinery. These actions produce a safe, sustained upregulation of autophagic flux associated with lifespan extension in model organisms. Spermidine is therefore a leading natural caloric-restriction mimetic for promoting healthy aging.
context.zh-TW: 精胺（Spermidine）透過多種互補機制增強自噬，顯著者包括誘發組蛋白 H3 去乙醯化，使自噬基因座處的染色質鬆動並促進其轉錄。它還透過依賴 hypusination 的 TFEB 轉譯以及對自噬機械的直接效應來支持自噬。這些作用產生與模式生物壽命延長相關的安全、持續的自噬流上調。因此精胺是促進健康老化的首要天然熱量限制擬似物。

subject: Spermidine

context.en-US: Spermidine supplementation rejuvenates age-impaired B cell responses by inducing autophagy in memory T and B lymphocytes, restoring their functional competence. The polyamine's ability to clear damaged organelles and enhance proteostasis in these cells counteracts the decline in vaccine responsiveness seen with immune aging. By supporting lymphoid cell fitness, spermidine addresses a key component of immunosenescence through an autophagy-dependent mechanism. These effects complement its broader rejuvenation of adaptive immunity.
context.zh-TW: 補充spermidine透過在記憶性T和B淋巴細胞中誘導自噬，恢復因年齡受損的B細胞反應，使其功能能力復原。此多胺清除受損胞器和增強這些細胞中蛋白質穩態的能力，抵消了免疫老化所見的疫苗反應性下降。透過支持淋巴樣細胞健康，spermidine透過依賴自噬的機制解決免疫老化的關鍵組成部分。這些效應補充了其對適應性免疫更廣泛的恢復作用。

source_document: _document_ - The autophagy enhancer spermidine reverses arterial aging.md

context.en-US: Spermidine serves as the essential aminobutyl donor for the post-translational hypusination of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5A (eIF5A), a modification catalyzed by deoxyhypusine synthase and deoxyhypusine hydroxylase. Hypusinated eIF5A is required for efficient translation of a subset of mRNAs with polyproline tracts, including that encoding the master autophagy regulator TFEB. By facilitating TFEB protein synthesis, spermidine upregulates the entire autophagy-lysosomal transcriptional program. This hypusination-dependent axis is a distinctive mechanistic link between polyamine metabolism and autophagic control.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine作為真核轉譯起始因子5A（eIF5A）轉譯後hypusination所必需的胺基丁基供體，此修飾由deoxyhypusine synthase和deoxyhypusine hydroxylase催化。經hypusination的eIF5A是高效轉譯含多脯胺酸序列的一類mRNA所必需的，包括編碼自噬主調控因子TFEB者。透過促進TFEB蛋白合成，spermidine上調整個自噬—溶酶體轉錄程序。此依賴hypusination的軸線是多胺代謝與自噬控制之間一個獨特的機制連結。

subject: Spermidine

context.en-US: Spermidine supplementation reduces oxidative stress in arterial and other tissues by enhancing autophagic and mitochondrial quality control, limiting the accumulation of reactive oxygen species-generating damaged organelles. The polyamine also exerts direct antioxidant effects and supports redox homeostasis through improved proteostasis. Reduced oxidative damage is a key mediator of spermidine's cardiovascular and cognitive protective effects. This antioxidant action is tightly coupled to its autophagy-inducing capacity.
context.zh-TW: 精胺補充透過增強自噬和粒線體品質控制，減少動脈和其他組織中的氧化壓力，限制產生活性氧的受損胞器之累積。此多胺也發揮直接抗氧化效應，並透過改善的蛋白質穩態支持氧化還原恆定性。降低的氧化損傷是精胺心血管和認知保護效應的關鍵介導者。此抗氧化作用與其誘發自噬的能力緊密耦合。

source_document: _document_ - The autophagy enhancer spermidine reverses arterial aging.md

subject: Spermidine

context.en-US: Spermidine promotes TFEB translation through hypusination of eIF5A, a modification essential for efficient translation of mRNAs containing polyproline tracts such as that of TFEB. By facilitating the synthesis of TFEB protein, spermidine expands the pool of the master regulator available for nuclear activation. This translational enhancement complements spermidine's other autophagy-inducing mechanisms, including histone deacetylation. The eIF5A-TFEB link provides a molecular explanation for spermidine's potent, safe induction of the lysosomal-autophagy network.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine 透過 eIF5A 的 hypusination 促進 TFEB 轉譯，此修飾對含有多脯胺酸序列（如 TFEB 者）的 mRNA 的有效轉譯至關重要。透過促進 TFEB 蛋白合成，spermidine 擴展了可用於核活化的主調控因子庫。此轉譯增強補充了 spermidine 的其他自噬誘導機制，包括組蛋白去乙醯化。eIF5A-TFEB 連結為 spermidine 強效、安全地誘導溶酶體—自噬網絡提供了分子解釋。

context.en-US: STUB1 (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, recognizes and ubiquitinates phosphorylated TFEB, targeting the transcription factor for proteasomal degradation. This mechanism ensures that TFEB levels are coupled to its phosphorylation state, providing a negative-feedback brake on sustained activation. By eliminating phosphorylated, cytosolically retained TFEB, STUB1 limits the accumulation of inactive protein and fine-tunes the amplitude of the autophagic response. The pathway connects TFEB turnover to the ubiquitin-proteasome system rather than to lysosomal degradation.
context.zh-TW: STUB1（CHIP）是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，辨識並泛素化磷酸化的 TFEB，將此轉錄因子標定為蛋白酶體降解。此機制確保 TFEB 水平與其磷酸化狀態耦合，提供對持續活化的負回饋制動。透過清除磷酸化、細胞質保留的 TFEB，STUB1 限制非活性蛋白的累積並微調自噬反應的幅度。此途徑將 TFEB 更新連結到泛素—蛋白酶體系統，而非溶酶體降解。

subject: TFE3

context.en-US: TFE3 targets include ATF4, an essential master regulator of the integrated stress response, in addition to autophagic and lysosomal genes. ChIP-seq analysis revealed a high overlap between genes regulated by TFE3 under starvation and ER stress. TFE3 thereby integrates cooperation between different cellular stress pathways. This positions TFE3 as a broad regulator linking the lysosomal program to the integrated stress response.
context.zh-TW: TFE3 的標的包括 ATF4（整合性壓力反應的必要主調控因子），以及自噬和溶酶體基因。ChIP-seq 分析顯示 TFE3 在飢餓和 ER 壓力下調節的基因高度重疊。因此 TFE3 整合不同細胞壓力途徑之間的合作。這將 TFE3 定位為連結溶酶體程序與整合性壓力反應的廣泛調節者。

source_document: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

context.en-US: TFE3 is activated in response to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress through a pathway that is mTORC1-independent but requires the ER stress sensor PERK. Under unfolded protein accumulation, PERK signaling promotes TFE3 nuclear translocation, engaging lysosomal and autophagic genes to alleviate proteotoxic burden. This distinct trigger allows TFE3 to contribute to the integrated stress response without relying on nutrient sensing. The mechanism expands the repertoire of stressors that can recruit the MiT/TFE degradative program.
context.zh-TW: TFE3 在回應內質網（ER）壓力時透過一條不依賴 mTORC1、但需要 ER 壓力感測器 PERK 的途徑被活化。在未折疊蛋白累積時，PERK 信號促進 TFE3 核轉位，啟動溶酶體和自噬基因以減輕蛋白毒性負擔。此獨特觸發因子使 TFE3 能在不依賴營養感知的情況下，貢獻於整合性壓力反應。此機制擴展了能夠招募 MiT/TFE 降解程序的壓力因子 repertoire。

context.en-US: TFE3 is, together with TFEB, a master regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, binding CLEAR elements to induce expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. Its activation occurs via mTORC1 inhibition, calcineurin signaling, and ER-stress-dependent PERK activation, providing partially distinct triggers from TFEB. TFE3 overexpression similarly expands lysosomal capacity and promotes autophagic flux. The overlapping master-regulator roles of TFE3 and TFEB ensure robustness in the control of cellular degradation.
context.zh-TW: TFE3 與 TFEB 一同是溶酶體生物發生的主調節者，結合 CLEAR 元件以誘發溶酶體和自噬基因的表現。其活化透過 mTORC1 抑制、calcineurin 信號和內質網壓力依賴的 PERK 活化發生，提供了與 TFEB 部分不同的觸發因子。TFE3 過度表現同樣擴展溶酶體能力並促進自噬流。TFE3 和 TFEB 重疊的主調節者角色確保了對細胞降解控制的穩健性。

context.en-US: TFE3, the closely related MiT/TFE family member, also binds CLEAR elements and induces lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy in response to nutrient deprivation and stress. Like TFEB, TFE3 is repressed by mTORC1 through phosphorylation and released upon starvation, calcineurin activation, or ER stress. The overlapping but non-identical target sets of TFEB and TFE3 provide redundancy and specificity in the lysosomal program. TFE3's distinct regulation, including PERK-dependent activation, broadens the stress-responsive control of degradation.
context.zh-TW: TFE3 是關係密切的 MiT/TFE 家族成員，同樣結合 CLEAR 元件，並在營養匱乏和壓力下誘發溶酶體生物發生與自噬。如同 TFEB，TFE3 經由磷酸化受 mTORC1 抑制，並在飢餓、calcineurin 活化或內質網壓力時釋放。TFEB 與 TFE3 重疊但非完全相同的標的組，提供了溶酶體程序中的冗餘與特異性。TFE3 獨特的調節——包括 PERK 依賴的活化——拓寬了對降解的壓力反應性控制。

subject: TFE3

context.en-US: TFE3 regulates osteoclast development by promoting the transition of mononucleated to multinucleated osteoclasts. This activation occurs downstream of the growth factors M-CSF and RANK and requires MAPK-dependent TFE3 phosphorylation. TFE3 thereby contributes to skeletal formation and remodeling through its control of osteoclast maturation. The role highlights TFE3's function in cell lineage decisions beyond lysosomal biogenesis.
context.zh-TW: TFE3 透過促進單核細胞向多核破骨細胞的轉變，調節破骨細胞發育。此活化發生於生長因子 M-CSF 和 RANK 下游，並需要依賴 MAPK 的 TFE3 磷酸化。因此 TFE3 透過控制破骨細胞成熟，促成骨骼形成和重塑。此角色凸顯 TFE3 在細胞譜系決定中超越溶酶體生物發生的功能。

source_document: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

context.en-US: TFE3 is recurrently involved in Xp11.2 translocation renal cell carcinomas, in which it fuses with partner genes such as ASPSCR1, PRCC, or SFPQ, creating chimeric transcription factors that drive tumorigenesis. These gene fusions define a distinct subset of RCC, often arising in children and young adults, with characteristic clear-cell or papillary features. The fusion proteins typically retain the TFE3 DNA-binding domain and are constitutively active, deregulating MiT/TFE target genes. Detection of TFE3 rearrangement is important for correct diagnosis and classification of these tumors.
context.zh-TW: TFE3 反覆參與 Xp11.2 轉位性腎細胞癌，在此它與 ASPSCR1、PRCC 或 SFPQ 等夥伴基因融合，創造出驅動腫瘤發生的嵌合轉錄因子。這些基因融合定義了 RCC 的一個獨特亞群，常發生於兒童和年輕成人，具有特徵性的透明細胞或乳突狀特徵。融合蛋白通常保留 TFE3 的 DNA 結合域並呈組成型活化，使 MiT/TFE 標的基因失調。偵測 TFE3 重排對於正確診斷和分類這些腫瘤至為重要。

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB is activated in aneuploid cells as a cellular response to lysosomal stress following lysosomal accumulation of undegraded autophagic cargo. This activation occurs through an mTORC1-independent mechanism involving TFEB nuclear translocation and upregulation of its downstream targets. The response appears wired to stimulate autophagosomal rather than lysosomal biogenesis in these cells. It represents an adaptive mechanism by which aneuploid cells cope with proteotoxicity.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 在非整倍體細胞中被活化，作為對溶酶體累積未降解自噬貨物後之溶酶體壓力的細胞反應。此活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的機制發生，涉及 TFEB 核轉位及其下游標靶的上調。此反應似乎被設計為刺激這些細胞的自噬體而非溶酶體生物發生。它代表非整倍體細胞應對蛋白毒性的適應機制。

source_document: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway, coordinating the expression of genes required for autophagosome formation, cargo recognition, lysosomal biogenesis, and substrate degradation. Its activation simultaneously boosts both the supply of autophagosomes and the degradative capacity of lysosomes, ensuring coherent flux rather than unbalanced initiation. TFEB thereby couples the two halves of autophagy—sequestration and degradation—into a single coordinated program. Dysregulation of this axis contributes to lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration, and cancer.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 是自噬—溶酶體途徑的主轉錄調控因子，協調自噬體形成、貨物辨識、溶酶體生物發生和受質降解所需基因的表現。其活化同時提升自噬體的供應和溶酶體的降解能力，確保協調的流而非不平衡的起始。TFEB 因此將自噬的兩半——隔離和降解——耦合為單一協調程序。此軸的失調促成溶酶體儲存障礙、神經退化和癌症。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

context.en-US: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé (BHD) syndrome, caused by Folliculin (FLCN) mutations, TFEB becomes hyperactivated and drives a renal cystic and tumor-prone phenotype. Loss of FLCN dysregulates mTOR and related signaling such that TFEB-mediated lysosomal and proliferative programs are inappropriately engaged in renal epithelial cells. This pathogenic role contrasts with TFEB's generally protective function in neurodegeneration and aging. The BHD example demonstrates that excessive or context-inappropriate TFEB activation can be deleterious.
context.zh-TW: 在由 Folliculin（FLCN）突變引起的 Birt-Hogg-Dubé（BHD）症候群中，TFEB 變得過度活化並驅動腎囊性和易長腫瘤的表型。FLCN 的缺失失調 mTOR 和相關信號，使得 TFEB 介導的溶酶體和增生程序在腎上皮細胞中不當地被啟動。此致病角色與 TFEB 在神經退化和老化中普遍保護性功能形成對比。BHD 例子證明了過度或背景不當的 TFEB 活化可能是有害的。

context.en-US: TFEB binds to Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation (CLEAR) elements—a conserved 10-base-pair motif (GTCACGTGAC) present in the promoters of numerous lysosomal and autophagy genes. Through this binding, TFEB drives the coordinated transcriptional upregulation of the entire autophagy-lysosomal network. CLEAR-mediated regulation allows cells to mount a unified response that expands degradative capacity in tandem with autophagic initiation. The CLEAR network is the molecular basis for TFEB's role as a master regulator of cellular clearance.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 結合至協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）元件——存在於眾多溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的保守 10 個鹼基對基序（GTCACGTGAC）。透過此結合，TFEB 驅動整個自噬—溶酶體網絡的協調轉錄上調。CLEAR 介導的調節使細胞能夠啟動統一的反應，在自噬起始的同時擴展降解能力。CLEAR 網絡是 TFEB 作為細胞清除主調控因子角色的分子的基礎。

context.en-US: TFEB controls glutamine metabolism by promoting transcription of glutaminase and related genes that support glutamine utilization for biosynthesis and energy production. In pancreatic cancer, TFEB-driven glutaminase expression supplies the carbon and nitrogen needed to sustain tumor growth under nutrient stress. This metabolic dimension reveals TFEB as a regulator not only of degradation but also of anabolic substrate flux. The link positions TFEB within the metabolic rewiring that characterizes malignancy.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 透過促進 glutaminase 及相關基因的轉錄來控制麩醯胺酸代謝，這些基因支持麩醯胺酸用於生物合成和能量產生的利用。在胰腺癌中，TFEB 驅動的 glutaminase 表現提供了在營養壓力下維持腫瘤生長所需的碳和氮。此代謝層面揭示 TFEB 不僅是降解的調節者，也是合成代謝受質通量的調節者。此連結將 TFEB 置於惡性腫瘤特徵性的代謝重編程中。

context.en-US: TFEB is the mammalian ortholog of C. elegans HLH-30, both belonging to the conserved MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors. They share the core function of activating lysosomal, autophagic, and lipolytic gene programs in response to nutrient deprivation through conserved CLEAR-like promoter elements. This orthology validates the use of the worm as a model for studying mammalian autophagy-lysosomal regulation. Findings in HLH-30 have repeatedly illuminated parallel mechanisms governing TFEB in humans.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 是線蟲 HLH-30 的哺乳動物同源物，兩者都屬於保守的 MiT/TFE 家族基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子。它們共享核心功能，即透過保守的 CLEAR 樣啟動子元件，在營養匱乏時活化溶酶體、自噬性和脂解性基因程序。這種同源關係驗證了使用線蟲作為研究哺乳動物自噬—溶酶體調節的模型。HLH-30 中的發現一再闡明了控制人類 TFEB 的平行機制。

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB regulates innate and adaptive immune responses, becoming activated during dendritic cell maturation to enhance antigen processing and presentation via expanded lysosomal and MHC-related machinery. By boosting degradative capacity, TFEB improves the efficiency of antigen degradation and epitope loading, strengthening T cell priming. TFEB activity also influences macrophage polarization and immune cell metabolism. These roles position the autophagy-lysosomal master regulator as an important modulator of immunity.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 調節先天和適應性免疫反應，在樹突細胞成熟過程中被活化，透過擴增的溶酶體和 MHC 相關機械來增強抗原處理與呈現。透過提升降解能力，TFEB 改善了抗原降解和表位加載的效率，強化了 T 細胞啟動。TFEB 活性也影響巨噬細胞極化和免疫細胞代謝。這些角色將自噬—溶酶體主調節者定位為免疫的重要調節者。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB undergoes SUMOylation at lysine 316, a small ubiquitin-like modifier conjugation that attenuates its transcriptional activity. SUMOylation typically modulates protein-protein interactions and subnuclear compartmentalization, and at K316 it dampens TFEB-driven expression of lysosomal genes. This modification adds another layer to the post-translational code governing TFEB, acting in opposition to activatory marks such as deacetylation. The reversibility of SUMOylation by SENPs allows dynamic tuning of the degradative program.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 在 lysine 316 發生 SUMOylation，這是一種削弱其轉錄活性的小型泛素樣修飾物共軛。SUMOylation 通常調節蛋白質—蛋白質交互作用和亞核區室化，在 K316 處它抑制 TFEB 驅動的溶酶體基因表現。此修飾為控制 TFEB 的轉譯後密碼增添了另一層次，作用與去乙醯化等活化標記相反。SUMOylation 可被 SENPs 逆轉，允許對降解程序進行動態微調。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

context.en-US: TFEB regulates lipid catabolism by upregulating genes involved in fatty acid import, beta-oxidation, lysosomal acid lipase (LAL)-mediated lipophagy, and the transcriptional coactivators PGC-1α and PPAR-α. Through these targets, TFEB coordinates the mobilization and oxidation of stored lipids during fasting and stress. This lipid-catabolic program complements TFEB's role in protein and organelle turnover, rendering it a comprehensive metabolic regulator. Enhanced TFEB activity improves lipid handling and protects against hepatic steatosis.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 透過上調參與脂肪酸輸入、β 氧化、溶酶體酸性脂肪酶（LAL）介導的脂噬，以及轉錄共活化因子 PGC-1α 和 PPAR-α 的基因，來調節脂質分解代謝。透過這些標的，TFEB 在禁食和壓力期間協調儲存脂質的動員和氧化。此脂質分解代謝程序補充了 TFEB 在蛋白質和胞器週轉中的角色，使它成為全面的代謝調節者。增強的 TFEB 活性改善脂質處理並保護對抗肝臟脂肪變性。

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, and its overexpression drives coordinated activation of numerous lysosomal genes encoding membrane proteins, hydrolases, and v-ATPase subunits. This global upregulation increases both the number and functional capacity of lysosomes, expanding degradative reserve. As the central node of the CLEAR network, TFEB integrates diverse stress signals into a unified lysosomal expansion program. Its master-regulator status makes it a prime target for therapies aimed at enhancing cellular clearance.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 是溶酶體生物發生的主轉錄調節者，其過度表現驅動編碼膜蛋白、水解酶和 v-ATPase 次單元的眾多溶酶體基因的協調活化。此全局上調增加了溶酶體的數量和功能能力，擴展了降解儲備。作為 CLEAR 網絡的中樞節點，TFEB 將多樣的壓力信號整合為統一的溶酶體擴張程序。其主調節者地位使它成為旨在增強細胞清除之療法的首要標靶。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB induces lysosomal exocytosis by increasing the number of lysosomes ready to dock and fuse with the plasma membrane and by eliciting intracellular calcium release through activation of its target gene TRPML1 (MCOLN1). This process promotes cellular clearance in several lysosomal storage disease cell models, including Sanfilippo syndrome, multiple sulfatase deficiency, and Batten disease. TFEB-mediated lysosomal exocytosis plays important roles in bone remodeling and copper homeostasis. Overexpression of TFEB or TFE3 is sufficient to induce lysosome fusion with the plasma membrane.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 透過增加準備停靠並與質膜融合的溶酶體數量，並經由活化其標的基因 TRPML1（MCOLN1）誘發細胞內鈣釋放，來誘導溶酶體胞吐。此過程在數種溶酶體儲存疾病細胞模型中促進細胞清除，包括 Sanfilippo 症候群、多重硫酸酯酶缺乏症和 Batten 病。TFEB 介導的溶酶體胞吐在骨重塑和銅恆定性中發揮重要作用。TFEB 或 TFE3 的過度表現足以誘導溶酶體與質膜融合。

source_document: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB activates lysosome biogenesis by binding CLEAR elements in the promoters of genes encoding lysosomal membrane proteins, hydrolases, and v-ATPase subunits, coordinately increasing lysosomal number and capacity. This transcriptional program ensures that autophagic demand is matched by degradative capacity, preventing futile autophagosome accumulation. TFEB activation therefore expands the entire lysosomal network rather than individual enzymes. The effect is a cornerstone of cellular adaptation to starvation and stress.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 透過結合編碼溶酶體膜蛋白、水解酶和 v-ATPase 次單元的基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件，活化溶酶體生物發生，協調性地增加溶酶體的數量與能力。此轉錄程序確保自噬需求由降解能力所匹配，防止徒勞的自噬體累積。因此 TFEB 活化擴展了整個溶酶體網絡而非個別酵素。此效應是細胞適應飢餓與壓力的基石。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: In a subset of translocation renal cell carcinomas (t(6;11) RCC), the TFEB gene is fused with the long non-coding RNA locus MALAT1, producing a MALAT1-TFEB fusion that drives overexpression of intact TFEB. The fusion places TFEB under the strong promoter activity of MALAT1, leading to constitutive activation of the lysosomal-autophagic and proliferative programs. This genetic rearrangement defines a distinct clinicopathologic entity of RCC with characteristic biphasic histology. The finding established TFEB as an oncogene when deregulated by chromosomal translocation.
context.zh-TW: 在一部分轉位性腎細胞癌（t(6;11) RCC）中，TFEB 基因與長鏈非編碼 RNA 基因座 MALAT1 融合，產生 MALAT1-TFEB 融合體，驅動完整 TFEB 的過度表現。此融合將 TFEB 置於 MALAT1 強啟動子活性之下，導致溶酶體—自噬性和增生性程序的組成型活化。此基因重排定義了一種具有特徵性雙相組織學的獨特 RCC 臨床病理實體。此發現確立了 TFEB 在因染色體轉位而失調時是一種致癌基因。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors, which also includes TFE3, MITF, and TFEC. Members of this family share conserved DNA-binding and dimerization domains and regulate overlapping sets of lysosomal and autophagic target genes. The family's defining feature is responsiveness to nutrient and stress signals that control nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. TFEB and TFE3 are the principal mediators of the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation (CLEAR) network.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFE 家族的基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，該家族也包括 TFE3、MITF 和 TFEC。此家族成員共享保守的 DNA 結合和二聚化結構域，並調節重疊的一組溶酶體和自噬標的基因的轉錄。該家族的定義特徵是對控制核質穿梭的營養和壓力信號的反應性。TFEB 和 TFE3 是協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）網絡的主要介導者。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB is activated in response to mitochondrial stress, a process requiring mitophagy machinery including PINK1, Parkin, Atg9A, and Atg5 to signal and enable TFEB nuclear translocation. As damaged mitochondria are selected for autophagic removal, TFEB coordinates a compensatory lysosomal and autophagic response that restores organelle quality. This coupling ensures that mitochondrial turnover is matched by degradative capacity. The axis links mitochondrial quality control to the broader autophagy-lysosomal network and to metabolic homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 在回應粒線體壓力時被活化，此過程需要包括 PINK1、Parkin、Atg9A 和 Atg5 在內的粒線體自噬機械來傳遞信號並促成 TFEB 核轉位。當受損粒線體被選擇進行自噬移除時，TFEB 協調一個代償性的溶酶體和自噬反應，以恢復胞器品質。此耦合確保粒線體週轉由降解能力所匹配。該軸將粒線體品質控制連結到更廣泛的自噬—溶酶體網絡以及代謝恆定性。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB activation is protective in neurodegenerative diseases because enhanced autophagy-lysosomal clearance reduces the accumulation of toxic protein aggregates such as amyloid-beta, tau, and alpha-synuclein. Genetic or pharmacological activation of TFEB in neuronal and glia models improves clearance and mitigates toxicity and behavioral deficits. The protective effect stems from TFEB's coordinated upregulation of both autophagosome biogenesis and lysosomal degradative capacity. Consequently, TFEB has emerged as a leading therapeutic target for Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, and related proteinopathies.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 活化在神經退化性疾病中具有保護作用，因為增強的自噬—溶酶體清除減少了 amyloid-beta、tau 和 alpha-synuclein 等毒性蛋白聚集物的累積。在神經元和膠質細胞模型中，TFEB 的基因或藥理活化改善了清除並減輕毒性和行為缺陷。保護效應源自 TFEB 對自噬體生物發生和溶酶體降解能力的協調上調。因此，TFEB 已成為帕金森氏症、阿茲海默症和相關蛋白病的主要治療標靶。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB is required for osteoclast function in vivo, as its depletion results in decreased expression of lysosomal genes, reduced lysosome number, and defective bone matrix resorption. RANK treatment promotes TFEB phosphorylation via PKCbeta kinase, leading to TFEB nuclear translocation and induction of lysosomal biogenesis. Nuclear TFEB facilitates secretion of lysosomal hydrolases at the site of bone resorption. This establishes TFEB as essential for skeletal homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 在活體中為破骨細胞功能所必需，因為其缺失導致溶酶體基因表現下降、溶酶體數量減少和骨基質吸收缺陷。RANK 處理經由 PKCbeta 激酶促進 TFEB 磷酸化，導致 TFEB 核轉位和溶酶體生物發生誘導。核 TFEB 促進溶酶體水解酶在骨吸收部位分泌。這確立了 TFEB 對骨骼恆定性的必要性。

source_document: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: Oxidation of TFEB at cysteine 212—for example by reactive oxygen species or oxidants—impairs mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at adjacent regulatory sites and thereby enhances TFEB activity. This redox-sensitive control links cellular oxidative status directly to activation of the lysosomal-autophagy program, functioning as a stress sensor. By relieving kinase repression under oxidative conditions, TFEB oxidation promotes clearance of damaged components that generate ROS. The C212 modification exemplifies how cysteine-based redox switches integrate stress signaling with degradative transcription.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的氧化——例如由活性氧物種或氧化劑引起——損害 mTORC1 介導的鄰近調節位點磷酸化，從而增強 TFEB 活性。這種對氧化還原敏感的控製將細胞氧化狀態直接連結到溶酶體—自噬程序的活化，作為一種壓力感測器。透過在氧化條件下解除激酶抑制，TFEB 氧化促進清除會產生 ROS 的受損組分。C212 修飾舉例說明了基於半胱胺酸的氧化還原方程序如何將壓力信號與降解轉錄整合。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: In pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDA), TFEB remains constitutively nuclear-localized and active independent of nutrient status, supporting the tumor's high demand for lysosomal degradation and metabolic flexibility. This aberrant activation promotes expression of glutaminase and other catabolic genes that fuel PDA growth under the harsh tumor microenvironment. The nutrient-independent nuclear TFEB state distinguishes PDA from normal epithelial regulation and contributes to therapy resistance. Targeting TFEB or its effectors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy in this lethal cancer.
context.zh-TW: 在胰腺導管腺癌（PDA）中，TFEB 持續性地核定位並維持活化，獨立於營養狀態，支持腫瘤對溶酶體降解和代謝靈活性的高需求。此異常活化促進了 glutaminase 和其他分解代謝基因的表現，在嚴苛的腫瘤微環境中供給 PDA 生長。此不依賴營養的核 TFEB 狀態將 PDA 與正常上皮調節區分開來，並促成治療抗性或耐藥。標靶 TFEB 或其效應物正被探索作為此致命癌症的治療策略。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB and the mitochondrial biogenesis coactivator PGC-1α form a positive feedback loop: PGC-1α modulates mitophagy by regulating TFEB expression, while TFEB induces PGC-1α transcription, reinforcing mitochondrial turnover and biogenesis. This reciprocal regulation couples lysosomal-autophagic clearance with mitochondrial network expansion under stress. The loop ensures coordinated enhancement of both degradative and biosynthetic mitochondrial programs. Its disruption impairs metabolic adaptation and is relevant to aging and myopathy.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 與粒線體生物發生共活化因子 PGC-1α 形成正向回饋環：PGC-1α 透過調節 TFEB 表現來調控粒線體自噬，而 TFEB 誘發 PGC-1α 轉錄，強化粒線體週轉與生物發生。此相互調節在壓力下將溶酶體—自噬性清除與粒線體網絡擴張耦合起來。此迴圈確保降解性和合成性粒線體程序的協調增強。其失調損害代謝適應，並與老化和肌病相關。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: S-sulfhydration of TFEB at cysteine 212, catalyzed by the cystathionine gamma-lyase (CTH)-derived hydrogen sulfide (H2S) system, promotes its nuclear translocation and activation. This post-translational modification, distinct from oxidation, converts C212 into a persulfide that alters TFEB interactions and favors a transcriptionally active state. The regulation ties sulfur metabolism and H2S signaling to the autophagy-lysosomal network, with implications for cardiovascular and neurodegenerative protection. It represents a gasotransmitter-based mechanism controlling cellular clearance.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的 S-硫化（S-sulfhydration），由 cystathionine gamma-lyase（CTH）衍生的硫化氫（H2S）系統催化，促進其核轉運和活化。此轉譯後修飾不同於氧化，將 C212 轉化為過硫化物，改變 TFEB 交互作用並有利於轉錄活化狀態。此調節將硫代謝和 H2S 信號聯繫到自噬—溶酶體網絡，對心血管和神經退化保護具有意義。它代表了一種控制細胞清除的氣體傳遞分子（gasotransmitter）基礎機制。

source_document: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB induces expression of TRPML1 (MCOLN1), its target gene encoding the lysosomal calcium release channel. The resulting lysosomal calcium release is required for TFEB-mediated lysosomal exocytosis and cellular clearance. In cells with loss-of-function TRPML1 mutations, TFEB fails to promote cellular clearance. This places TRPML1 as a key effector linking TFEB to lysosomal calcium signaling and exocytosis.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 誘導 TRPML1（MCOLN1）的表現，這是編碼溶酶體鈣釋放通道的標的基因。由此產生的溶酶體鈣釋放是 TFEB 介導的溶酶體胞吐和細胞清除所必需。在 TRPML1 功能缺失突變的細胞中，TFEB 無法促進細胞清除。這使 TRPML1 成為將 TFEB 與溶酶體鈣訊號和胞吐連結的關鍵效應物。

source_document: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md

context.en-US: Thymic involution is the age-dependent regression of thymic epithelial space and function, progressively diminishing the export of naïve T cells to the periphery. This contraction of the naïve T cell repertoire underlies reduced adaptive immune competence, poor vaccine responses, and increased infection risk characteristic of immune aging. The process is driven by intrinsic stromal changes, sex steroids, and accumulated damage, and is only partially compensated by peripheral homeostatic proliferation. Interventions that enhance autophagy can partially counter thymic senescence and restore T cell output.
context.zh-TW: 胸腺退化是胸腺上皮空間和功能的年齡依賴性退化，逐漸減少初始 T 細胞向外周的輸出。這種初始 T 細胞庫的萎縮是免疫老化特徵——適應性免疫能力降低、疫苗反應差和感染風險增加——的基礎。此過程由內在基質變化、性類固醇和累積損傷驅動，並僅由周邊恆定態增殖部分補償。增強自噬的介入可部分抵消胸腺衰老並恢復 T 細胞輸出。

context.en-US: Tankyrase 1 (TNKS1) poly-ADP-ribosylates (PARsylates) TFEB, a modification that promotes its nuclear translocation and activation of target genes. PARsylation addsADP-ribose polymers that alter TFEB interactions and trafficking, providing a non-phosphorylation route to TFEB activation. This modification broadens the enzymatic toolkit—alongside kinases, phosphatases, acetylases, and ubiquitin ligases—that regulates the autophagy-lysosomal master switch. The TNKS1-TFEB relationship suggests potential crosstalk with Wnt/β-catenin and other PARsylation-dependent pathways.
context.zh-TW: Tankyrase 1（TNKS1）對 TFEB 進行聚 ADP-核糖基化（PARsylation），此修飾促進其核轉運和標的基因的活化。PARsylation 添加 ADP-核糖聚合物，改變 TFEB 交互作用和運輸，提供一條非磷酸化的 TFEB 活化路線。此修飾拓寬了調節自噬—溶酶體主開關的酵素工具箱——與激酶、磷酸酶、乙醯酶和泛素連接酶並列。TNKS1-TFEB 關係暗示了與 Wnt/β-catenin 和其他依賴 PARsylation 途徑的潛在串擾。

context.en-US: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
context.zh-TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

context.en-US: TRPML1 is the principal lysosomal Ca2+ release channel, activated by PI(3,5)P2 and other cues to efflux Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol. The released Ca2+ activates calcineurin, driving TFEB/TFE3 nuclear translocation and thereby coupling ion flux to transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis. TRPML1 also participates in lysosomal trafficking and autophagosome-lysosome fusion. Loss of TRPML1 causes mucolipidosis type IV, a lysosomal storage disorder, confirming its essential role in degradative homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: TRPML1 是主要的溶酶體 Ca2+ 釋放通道，由 PI(3,5)P2 及其他線索活化，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔流出至細胞質。釋出的 Ca2+ 活化 calcineurin，驅動 TFEB/TFE3 核轉運，從而將離子流與溶酶體生物發生的轉錄活化耦合起來。TRPML1 亦參與溶酶體運輸以及自噬體—溶酶體融合。TRPML1 的缺失導致黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV），一種溶酶體儲存障礙，確認了其在降解恆定性中的必要角色。

context.en-US: The TSC1-TSC2 tumor-suppressor complex acts as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP) for the small G protein Rheb, converting active GTP-bound Rheb to its inactive GDP-bound form. Because only GTP-Rheb directly activates mTORC1, TSC1/TSC2 functions as a critical upstream brake on mTORC1 in response to energy, oxygen, and growth-factor signals. Loss-of-function mutations in TSC1 or TSC2 cause tuberous sclerosis complex, characterized by constitutive mTORC1 activation, hamartoma formation, and autophagy suppression. The complex is therefore a major gatekeeper of mTORC1 and cellular growth.
context.zh-TW: TSC1-TSC2 腫瘤抑制複合物作為小 G 蛋白 Rheb 的 GTP 酶活化蛋白（GAP），將活化的 GTP 結合態 Rheb 轉化為其失活的 GDP 結合態。由於只有 GTP-Rheb 直接活化 mTORC1，TSC1/TSC2 在回應能量、氧氣和生長因子信號時，作為 mTORC1 關鍵的上游制動。TSC1 或 TSC2 的功能缺失突變導致結節性硬化症複合體，其特徵為 mTORC1 組成型活化、錯構瘤形成和自噬抑制。因此該複合物是 mTORC1 與細胞生長的主要守門者。

context.en-US: The ULK1 complex, composed of ULK1 or ULK2 kinase together with Atg13, FIP200, and Atg101, acts as the primary initiator of autophagosome formation downstream of nutrient sensing. Under starvation, AMPK directly activates ULK1 while mTORC1 is withdrawn, allowing the complex to phosphorylate targets and recruit the downstream PI3K III/Beclin 1 nucleation machinery. ULK1 kinase activity is essential for the localized recruitment of ATG proteins to the phagophore assembly site and for the earliest steps of membrane expansion. Thus the ULK1 complex serves as the integration point that converts nutrient and energy signals into the physical initiation of autophagosome biogenesis.
context.zh-TW: ULK1複合體由ULK1或ULK2激酶與Atg13、FIP200和Atg101組成，作為營養感知下游自噬體形成的主要起始者。在飢餓下，AMPK直接活化ULK1，同時mTORC1被撤除，使該複合體能磷酸化標靶並招募下游的PI3K III/Beclin 1成核機制。ULK1激酶活性對於ATG蛋白局部招募至吞噬泡組裝位點以及膜擴展的最早步驟至關重要。因此，ULK1複合體作為將營養和能量訊號轉化為自噬體生物發生實質起始的整合點。

context.en-US: USP30 is a mitochondrial deubiquitinase that opposes Parkin-mediated mitophagy by removing ubiquitin chains from outer mitochondrial membrane proteins. Its inhibition or loss enhances mitophagy, reduces alpha-synuclein pathology, and protects dopaminergic neurons in Parkinson's disease models. USP30 therefore acts as a negative regulator of mitophagy and a promising therapeutic target. Selective USP30 inhibitors such as MTX115325 have validated this approach in vivo.
context.zh-TW: USP30 是一種粒線體去泛素酶，透過移除粒線體外膜蛋白上的泛素鏈，拮抗 Parkin 介導的 mitophagy。其抑制或缺失增強 mitophagy、減少 alpha-synuclein 病理，並在帕金森氏症模型中保護多巴胺神經元。因此 USP30 作為 mitophagy 的負向調節者和有前景的治療標靶。MTX115325 等選擇性 USP30 抑制劑已在活體中驗證此方法。

context.en-US: Yoshinori Ohsumi was awarded the 2016 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his pioneering work using yeast genetics to identify the core autophagy-related (ATG) genes that govern the process. Through systematic mutagenesis screens, he uncovered the molecular machinery responsible for autophagosome formation, including the ubiquitin-like conjugation systems that build the phagophore membrane. His discoveries established autophagy as a genetically tractable and evolutionarily conserved degradation pathway, providing the conceptual framework for all subsequent mammalian autophagy research. The recognition underscored the fundamental importance of autophagy in cellular homeostasis, development, and human disease.
context.zh-TW: 大隅良典（Yoshinori Ohsumi）因開創性地利用酵母遺傳學鑑定出主導此過程的核心自噬相關（ATG）基因，而獲頒2016年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。透過系統性的突變篩選，他揭示了負責自噬體形成的分子機制，包括建構吞噬泡膜的泛素樣共軛系統。他的發現確立了自噬作為一種可遺傳操作且演化上保守的降解途徑，為後續所有哺乳動物自噬研究提供了概念框架。此項榮譽凸顯了自噬在細胞穩態、發育和人類疾病中的根本重要性。

context.en-US: Zellweger syndrome, the most severe form of the Zellweger spectrum of peroxisome biogenesis disorders, is caused by mutations in PEX genes required for peroxisome assembly and matrix protein import. Affected individuals lack functional peroxisomes, leading to accumulation of very-long-chain fatty acids, bile acid intermediates, and pipecolic acid, with profound neurologic, hepatic, and skeletal abnormalities. The spectrum's severity correlates with the degree of residual peroxisomal function. These disorders highlight the non-redundant essentiality of peroxisomes in human development.
context.zh-TW: Zellweger 症候群是 Zellweger 譜系過氧化體生物發生障礙中最嚴重的形式，由組裝過氧化體和基質蛋白輸入所需的 PEX 基因突變所引起。患者缺乏功能性過氧化體，導致極長鏈脂肪酸、膽汁酸中間物和哌可酸（pipecolic acid）累積，伴隨嚴重的神經、肝臟和骨骼異常。此譜系的嚴重程度與殘餘過氧化體功能程度相關。這些障礙凸顯了過氧化體在人類發育中非冗余的必要性。

context.en-US: ZKSCAN3 is a zinc-finger transcription factor that represses the expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes, acting in opposition to TFEB/TFE3. Under basal conditions it limits autophagic and lysosomal capacity, and its inhibition or loss enhances cellular clearance. ZKSCAN3 thereby functions as a transcriptional brake on the degradative network, complementary to the post-translational repression by mTORC1. Targeting ZKSCAN3 has been proposed as a strategy to boost autophagy in disease.
context.zh-TW: ZKSCAN3 是一種鋅指轉錄因子，抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現，作用與 TFEB/TFE3 相反。在基礎條件下它限制自噬和溶酶體能力，其抑制或缺失則增強細胞清除。因此 ZKSCAN3 作為降解網絡的轉錄性制動，補充了 mTORC1 的轉譯後抑制。標靶 ZKSCAN3 已被提議作為在疾病中提升自噬的策略。

context.en-US: Autophagy is coupled to the sex-specific cell-death pathways: male neurons undergo autophagy more readily and die under starvation/OGD, while female neurons mobilize fatty acids and depend less on autophagy (Du et al., J Biol Chem 2009). After stroke, males rapidly induce canonical autophagy (Beclin-1↑, LC3-II↑, p62↓) whereas females use a Beclin-1-independent (ATG7-dependent) route (Patrizz et al., Cells 2021); males show higher basal Beclin-1/LC3 in cardiac tissue (Oliván et al., 2014).
context.zh-TW: 自噬與性別特異的細胞死亡途徑相耦合：雄性神經元較易進行自噬並在飢餓/OGD 下死亡，而雌性神經元動員脂肪酸、較不依賴自噬（Du 等，J Biol Chem 2009）。中風後雄性迅速誘導典型自噬（Beclin-1↑、LC3-II↑、p62↓），而雌性使用不依賴 Beclin-1（依賴 ATG7）的途徑（Patrizz 等，Cells 2021）；雄性心臟組織具較高的基礎 Beclin-1/LC3（Oliván 等，2014）。

context.en-US: Estrogen is bidirectional in autophagy: it suppresses autophagy in ischemic neurons (via mTOR-ULK1), limiting autophagic cell death in females, but promotes prosurvival autophagy in ER+ breast cancer cells, driving anti-estrogen resistance — the same hormone acting in opposite directions by tissue and disease context.
context.zh-TW: 雌激素對自噬具雙向調控：在缺血神經元中抑制自噬（經 mTOR-ULK1），限制女性自噬性細胞死亡；但在 ER+ 乳癌細胞中促進促存活自噬，驅動抗雌激素抗藥性——同一荷爾蒙依組織與疾病脈絡而反向作用。

context.en-US: Atg4 cysteine protease cleaves the C-terminal extension of Atg8 to expose glycine, enabling phosphatidylethanolamine conjugation. Processing is the prerequisite for lipidation.
context.zh-TW: Atg4 半胱氨酸蛋白酶切割 Atg8 C 端延伸以暴露甘胺酸，使磷脂醯乙醇胺接合得以進行。加工是脂化的先決條件。

context.en-US: Mammalian LC3A/B/C proteins are the Atg8 family members executing phagophore expansion. Homology anchors the yeast-to-mammal mapping.
context.zh-TW: 哺乳動物 LC3A/B/C 蛋白是執行吞噬泡擴展的 Atg8 家族成員。同源錨定酵母到哺乳動物的對應。

context.en-US: Lipidated Atg8 on the phagophore is the binding site for the p62 cargo adapter linking ubiquitinated cargo to the membrane. Binding couples cargo to engulfment.
context.zh-TW: 吞噬泡上脂化的 Atg8 是 p62 貨物接合蛋白的結合位點，將泛素化貨物連結到膜。結合將貨物耦合到吞噬。

context.en-US: The E1 enzyme Atg7 conjugates Atg4-processed Atg8/LC3-I to phosphatidylethanolamine with Atg3 as E2. Activation is the lipidation cascade.
context.zh-TW: E1 酶 Atg7 以 Atg3 為 E2 將 Atg4 處理的 Atg8/LC3-I 接合到磷脂醯乙醇胺。活化是脂化級聯。

context.en-US: Fed-state mTORC1 phosphorylates Atg13 at Ser258/316/320 to hold the ULK1 complex inactive. No Atg13-phospho triple exists yet.
context.zh-TW: 進食狀態 mTORC1 在 Ser258/316/320 磷酸化 Atg13 以維持 ULK1 複合體失活。尚無 Atg13 磷酸化 triple。

context.en-US: Dephosphorylated Atg13 conformation enhances ULK1 kinase activation and oligomerization. Activation is the initiation switch.
context.zh-TW: 去磷酸化 Atg13 構象增強 ULK1 激酶活化與寡聚化。活化是起始開關。

context.en-US: ULK1 phosphorylation of Atg14 boosts Vps34 lipid kinase activity for nucleation. Phosphorylation links initiation to nucleation.
context.zh-TW: ULK1 磷酸化 Atg14 提升 Vps34 脂質激酶活性以供成核。磷酸化將起始連結到成核。

context.en-US: Atg14 targets complex I to the phagophore, directing PtdIns3P production for nucleation. Activation is the complex-I output.
context.zh-TW: Atg14 將複合體 I 標定到吞噬泡，指導 PtdIns3P 產生以供成核。活化是複合體 I 輸出。

context.en-US: The Atg14 N-terminal coiled-coil binds Beclin1 in complex I, distinct from the UVRAG complex II. Binding defines complex-I assembly; canonical filename Beclin1 used.
context.zh-TW: Atg14 N 端捲曲螺旋在複合體 I 結合 Beclin1，不同於 UVRAG 複合體 II。結合定義複合體 I 組裝；使用典型檔名 Beclin1。

context.en-US: Atg101 binds the Atg13 N-terminus and protects it against proteasomal turnover. Regulation is the stabilization mechanism.
context.zh-TW: Atg101 結合 Atg13 N 端並保護其免於蛋白酶體更新。調節是穩定機制。

context.en-US: Atg101 knockdown destabilizes Atg13, abolishes ULK1 integrity and blocks autophagosome formation; metazoan-specific with no yeast ortholog. Requirement is the integrity dependency.
context.zh-TW: Atg101 敲低使 Atg13 不穩定、廢除 ULK1 完整並阻斷自噬體形成；後生動物特異，無酵母同源。必要性是完整性依賴。

context.en-US: The Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 complex is required for LGG-1/LGG-2 lipidation and autophagosome formation. Requirement is the conjugation dependency.
context.zh-TW: Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 複合體為 LGG-1/LGG-2 脂化與自噬體形成所需。必要性是接合依賴。

context.en-US: atg-16.2 is induced during fasting and starvation in an HLH-30-dependent manner. Regulation extends the HLH-30 program to the conjugation complex.
context.zh-TW: atg-16.2 在禁食與飢餓期間以 HLH-30 依賴方式誘發。調節將 HLH-30 程序延伸到接合複合體。

context.en-US: Yeast Atg15 lipase degrades autophagic-body and lipid-droplet lipids in the vacuole; loss causes droplet accumulation and starvation inviability. Promotion is the vacuolar lipase output.
context.zh-TW: 酵母 Atg15 脂肪酶在液泡降解自噬體與脂滴脂質；缺失導致脂滴累積與飢餓致死。促進是液泡脂肪酶輸出。

context.en-US: Mammalian LIPA is the counterpart of yeast Atg15; deficiency causes Wolman disease and CESD. Homology maps vacuolar lipase to lysosomal lipase.
context.zh-TW: 哺乳動物 LIPA 是酵母 Atg15 的對應物；缺乏導致 Wolman 病與 CESD。同源將液泡脂肪酶對應到溶酶體脂肪酶。

context.en-US: LGG-1 lipidates into the autophagosome membrane as a structural component. Requirement is the membrane-integration dependency.
context.zh-TW: LGG-1 脂化進入自噬體膜作為結構成分。必要性是膜整合依賴。

context.en-US: lgg-1 transcription is fasting-induced in an HLH-30-dependent manner. Regulation extends the fasting program to the Atg8 ortholog.
context.zh-TW: lgg-1 轉錄在禁食以 HLH-30 依賴方式誘發。調節將禁食程序延伸到 Atg8 同源。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 BH3-domain binding sequesters Beclin1 and blocks VPS34 nucleation. Inhibition is the survival-to-autophagy brake.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 BH3 結構域結合隔離 Beclin1 並阻斷 VPS34 成核。抑制是存活到自噬的煞車。

context.en-US: ULK1 Ser14 phosphorylation of Beclin1 enhances Vps34 complex activity. Phosphorylation links initiation to nucleation.
context.zh-TW: ULK1 Ser14 磷酸化 Beclin1 增強 Vps34 複合體活性。磷酸化將起始連結到成核。

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylation of Beclin1 promotes Vps34 interaction for starvation-induced autophagy, distinct from the SIRT1-TFEB edge. Deacetylation is the acetylation gate.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 Beclin1 促進 Vps34 交互以供飢餓誘發自噬，不同於 SIRT1-TFEB 邊。去乙醯化是乙醯化閘門。

context.en-US: JNK-mediated Bcl-2 phosphorylation releases Beclin1 for VPS34 nucleation. Phosphorylation is the stress-release mechanism.
context.zh-TW: JNK 介導的 Bcl-2 磷酸化釋放 Beclin1 以供 VPS34 成核。磷酸化是壓力釋放機制。

context.en-US: TFEB is one of four vertebrate MiTF TFE members. Membership anchors the family to the lysosomal program.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 是四個脊椎動物 MiTF TFE 成員之一。成員關係將家族錨定到溶酶體程序。

context.en-US: The family governs lysosomal biogenesis, autophagic flux, lipophagy and mitophagy. Regulation is the family-level program.
context.zh-TW: 家族掌管溶酶體生合成、自噬流、脂噬與粒線體自噬。調節是家族層級程序。

context.en-US: The MiT/TFE subfamily including TFEB belongs to the bHLH-LZ factor class. Classification nests the subfamily.
context.zh-TW: 包括 TFEB 的 MiT/TFE 亞家族屬於 bHLH-LZ 因子類。歸類嵌套亞家族。

context.en-US: Starvation is the strongest physiological inducer of autophagy. Induction is the fasting-to-clearance coupling.
context.zh-TW: 飢餓是最強的自噬生理誘發因子。誘發是禁食到清除的耦合。

context.en-US: Starvation inhibits mTORC1 leading to ULK1 activation. Inhibition is the nutrient-off switch.
context.zh-TW: 飢餓抑制 mTORC1 導致 ULK1 活化。抑制是營養關閉開關。

context.en-US: Starvation activates AMPK as the energy-deficit sensor. Activation parallels mTORC1 inhibition.
context.zh-TW: 飢餓活化 AMPK 作為能量虧缺感受器。活化與 mTORC1 抑制平行。

context.en-US: Nutrient levels dictate metabolic priorities and autophagic activity with scarcity activating clearance. Regulation is the supply-to-degradation coupling.
context.zh-TW: 營養水平決定代謝優先與自噬活性，匱乏活化清除。調節是供應到降解的耦合。

context.en-US: mTORC1 is the master nutrient sensor active under high-nutrient conditions. Sensing is the detector direction of the regulation pair.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 是在高營養下活化的主要營養感受器。感知是調節對的偵測方向。

context.en-US: Lysosomal acid lipase hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered via lipophagy. Mediation is the enzymatic execution.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶水解經由脂噬遞送的膽固醇酯與甘油三酯。媒介是酶促執行。

context.en-US: Lysosomal acid lipase is transcriptionally induced by TFEB during nutrient deprivation. Regulation extends TFEB to lipid catabolism.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶在營養剝奪期間由 TFEB 轉錄誘發。調節將 TFEB 延伸到脂質分解。

context.en-US: Lysosomal lipolysis is primarily executed by lysosomal acid lipase. Requirement is the enzyme dependency.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體脂解主要由溶酶體酸性脂肪酶執行。必要性是酶依賴。

context.en-US: HLH-30 is the activator arm of the MXL-3/HLH-30 lipolysis switch. Regulation is the fasting-on direction.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 是 MXL-3/HLH-30 脂解開關的活化臂。調節是禁食開啟方向。

context.en-US: MXL-3 is the repressor arm limiting lipolysis under fed conditions. Repression is the fed-off direction.
context.zh-TW: MXL-3 是在進食下限制脂解的抑制臂。抑制是進食關閉方向。

context.en-US: PtdIns(3,5)P2 directly binds and activates the TRPML1 calcium channel. Activation couples phosphoinositide to calcium release.
context.zh-TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2 直接結合並活化 TRPML1 鈣通道。活化將磷酸肌醇耦合到鈣釋放。

context.en-US: PtdIns(3,5)P2-TRPML1 signaling is required for autophagic lysosome reformation. Regulation is the lipid-to-scission coupling.
context.zh-TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2-TRPML1 訊號為自噬性溶酶體重組所需。調節是脂質到分裂的耦合。

context.en-US: Phosphoinositide signaling drives phagocytic lysosome reformation membrane remodeling. Regulation parallels the ALR edge.
context.zh-TW: 磷酸肌醇訊號驅動吞噬性溶酶體重組膜重塑。調節與 ALR 邊平行。

context.en-US: Reformation rebuilds a fresh pool of functional lysosomes. Generation is the recycling output.
context.zh-TW: 重組重建新鮮功能性溶酶體池。產生是回收輸出。

context.en-US: PtdIns(3,5)P2-activated TRPML1 calcium release drives tubule scission. Regulation is the calcium-to-scission coupling.
context.zh-TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2 活化的 TRPML1 鈣釋放驅動小管分裂。調節是鈣到分裂的耦合。

context.en-US: KIF5B motors extend reformation tubules during ALR. Regulation is the motility input.
context.zh-TW: KIF5B 馬達在 ALR 延伸重組小管。調節是運動輸入。

context.en-US: Trehalose acts as an autophagy inducer. Induction is mTORC1-independent.
context.zh-TW: 海藻糖作為自噬誘發因子。誘發不依賴 mTORC1。

context.en-US: Trehalose induces TFEB nuclear translocation independent of mTORC1. Activation is the disaccharide-to-TFEB route.
context.zh-TW: 海藻糖不依賴 mTORC1 誘發 TFEB 核轉位。活化是雙醣到 TFEB 路徑。

context.en-US: The DEPDC5-containing GATOR1 complex is the GAP converting RagA/B-GTP to GDP. Inhibition is the amino-acid-off switch.
context.zh-TW: 含 DEPDC5 的 GATOR1 複合體是將 RagA/B-GTP 轉 GDP 的 GAP。抑制是胺基酸關閉開關。

context.en-US: GATOR1 keeps mTORC1 off in starvation via Rag inactivation. Inhibition is the starvation brake.
context.zh-TW: GATOR1 在飢餓經由 Rag 失活維持 mTORC1 關閉。抑制是飢餓煞車。

context.en-US: GATOR1 is the DEPDC5-NPRL2-NPRL3 heterotrimer. Composition defines the GAP complex.
context.zh-TW: GATOR1 是 DEPDC5-NPRL2-NPRL3 異三聚體。組成定義 GAP 複合體。

context.en-US: GATOR2 suppresses GATOR1 GAP activity when amino acids are abundant. Inhibition is the sufficiency release.
context.zh-TW: GATOR2 在胺基酸充足時抑制 GATOR1 GAP 活性。抑制是充足釋放。

context.en-US: GATOR2 activates mTORC1 indirectly via GATOR1 inhibition under amino-acid sufficiency. Activation is the sufficiency relay.
context.zh-TW: GATOR2 在胺基酸充足經由 GATOR1 抑制間接活化 mTORC1。活化是充足接力。

context.en-US: Leucine-free Sestrin2 binds and blocks GATOR2. Inhibition is the leucine-off switch.
context.zh-TW: 無白胺酸 Sestrin2 結合並阻斷 GATOR2。抑制是白胺酸關閉開關。

context.en-US: Arginine-free CASTOR complex binds and blocks GATOR2. Inhibition is the arginine-off switch.
context.zh-TW: 無精胺酸 CASTOR 複合體結合並阻斷 GATOR2。抑制是精胺酸關閉開關。

context.en-US: Arginine-free CASTOR1-CASTOR2 heterodimer binds and represses GATOR2. Parallel inhibition to the CASTOR1 edge.
context.zh-TW: 無精胺酸 CASTOR1-CASTOR2 異二聚體結合並抑制 GATOR2。與 CASTOR1 邊平行的抑制。

context.en-US: Arginine binding dissociates CASTOR from GATOR2. Regulation is the amino-acid sensor direction.
context.zh-TW: 精胺酸結合使 CASTOR 從 GATOR2 解離。調節是胺基酸感知方向。

context.en-US: mLST8 loss abolishes AKT-S473, SGK1 and PKCalpha phosphorylation by mTORC2. Requirement is the assembly dependency.
context.zh-TW: mLST8 缺失廢除 mTORC2 對 AKT-S473、SGK1 與 PKCα 磷酸化。必要性是組裝依賴。

context.en-US: Akt phosphorylation inhibits the TSC1/TSC2 complex, raising Rheb-GTP. Inhibition is the growth-factor release of the brake.
context.zh-TW: Akt 磷酸化抑制 TSC1/TSC2 複合體，提高 Rheb-GTP。抑制是生長因子釋放煞車。

context.en-US: Akt phosphorylation relieves PRAS40-mediated mTORC1 inhibition. Phosphorylation is the canonical release.
context.zh-TW: Akt 磷酸化解除 PRAS40 介導的 mTORC1 抑制。磷酸化是典型釋放。

context.en-US: Class-I PI3K-Akt signaling inhibits autophagy via mTORC1 activation and TFEB-S467 retention, distinct from pro-autophagy class-III PI3K. Inhibition is the fed-state brake.
context.zh-TW: I 類 PI3K-Akt 經由 mTORC1 活化與 TFEB-S467 滯留抑制自噬，不同於促自噬的 III 類 PI3K。抑制是進食煞車。

context.en-US: The lysosomal amino-acid sensing axis regulates mTORC1 recruitment and activation. Regulation is the hub triple.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體胺基酸感知軸調節 mTORC1 招募與活化。調節是樞紐 triple。

context.en-US: The lysosomal arginine transporter SLC38A9 is required for arginine-dependent mTORC1 activation. Activation is the transporter input.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體精胺酸轉運體 SLC38A9 為精胺酸依賴 mTORC1 活化所需。活化是轉運體輸入。

context.en-US: S6K1 is the canonical T389 downstream effector of mTORC1. Relationship is the textbook kinase-substrate pair.
context.zh-TW: S6K1 是 mTORC1 典型的 T389 下游效應器。關係是教科書激酶—受質對。

context.en-US: S6K1 phosphorylation of ribosomal protein S6 defines its substrate. Phosphorylation is the translation-output step.
context.zh-TW: S6K1 磷酸化核糖體蛋白 S6 定義其受質。磷酸化是轉譯輸出步驟。

context.en-US: Tuberin TSC2 is the catalytic GAP for Rheb. Inhibition is the GTPase-off switch.
context.zh-TW: Tuberin TSC2 是 Rheb 的催化 GAP。抑制是 GTPase 關閉開關。

context.en-US: Germline TSC2 loss causes the TSC hamartoma syndrome. Causation is the genetic etiology.
context.zh-TW: 生殖系 TSC2 缺失導致 TSC 錯構瘤症候群。因果是遺傳病因。

context.en-US: Energy-stress AMPK phosphorylates the TSC complex at S1387 to activate it. Phosphorylation is the energy-on switch.
context.zh-TW: 能量壓力 AMPK 在 S1387 磷酸化 TSC 複合體以活化它。磷酸化是能量開啟開關。

context.en-US: MAPK inputs tune TFEB with ERK retaining cytosolic and p38 driving nuclear. Regulation is the hub triple.
context.zh-TW: MAPK 輸入調節 TFEB，ERK 滯留胞質而 p38 驅動入核。調節是樞紐 triple。

context.en-US: Autophagic recycling of nutrients during fasting supports energy homeostasis. Support is the clearance-to-balance output.
context.zh-TW: 禁食期間自噬回收營養支持能量恆定。支持是清除到平衡的輸出。

context.en-US: MITF induces CTSK along with CLCN7/OSTM1/ACP5 in osteoclasts. Regulation is the osteoclast program.
context.zh-TW: MITF 在蝕骨細胞誘發 CTSK 及 CLCN7/OSTM1/ACP5。調節是蝕骨程序。

context.en-US: CTSK loss-of-function causes the osteosclerotic dysplasia pycnodysostosis. Causation is the genetic etiology.
context.zh-TW: CTSK 功能缺失導致骨硬化發育不良緻密骨發育不全。因果是遺傳病因。

context.en-US: Odanacatib is the selective cathepsin K inhibitor reaching Phase III for osteoporosis. Inhibition is the pharmacological edge.
context.zh-TW: Odanacatib 是進入骨質疏鬆 III 期選擇性組織蛋白酶 K 抑制劑。抑制是藥理邊。

context.en-US: Monocyte/macrophage lineage derives into osteoclasts under RANKL plus M-CSF. Induction is the differentiation drive.
context.zh-TW: 單核/巨噬細胞譜系在 RANKL 加 M-CSF 下分化為蝕骨細胞。誘發是分化驅動。

context.en-US: V-ATPase acidifies the resorption lacuna near pH 4.5 for matrix degradation. Requirement is the acidification dependency.
context.zh-TW: V-ATPase 酸化吸收陷窩至約 pH 4.5 以降解基質。必要性是酸化依賴。

context.en-US: SIRT2 deacetylates BRCA1 to promote damage-foci localization; knockdown impairs homologous recombination. Deacetylation is the repair-licensing step.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 BRCA1 以促進損傷灶定位；敲低損害同源重組。去乙醯化是修復許可步驟。

context.en-US: BRCA1 is essential for homologous-recombination repair of double-strand breaks via RAD51 loading. Requirement is the repair dependency.
context.zh-TW: BRCA1 經由 RAD51 裝載為雙股斷裂同源重組修復所必需。必要性是修復依賴。

context.en-US: B cells depend on autophagy for survival, differentiation and memory with Atg5/Atg7 knockout defective. Requirement is the lymphocyte dependency.
context.zh-TW: B 細胞依賴自噬存活、分化與記憶，Atg5/Atg7 敲除缺陷。必要性是淋巴細胞依賴。

context.en-US: Worm SIR-2.1 NAD-dependent deacetylase regulates lifespan and stress resistance. Regulation is the aging output.
context.zh-TW: 線蟲 SIR-2.1 NAD 依賴去乙醯酶調節壽命與壓力抗性。調節是老化輸出。

context.en-US: SIR-2.1 activates autophagy via DAF-16/HLH-30 during dietary restriction. Activation is the DR-to-clearance route.
context.zh-TW: SIR-2.1 在飲食限制經由 DAF-16/HLH-30 活化自噬。活化是 DR 到清除路徑。

context.en-US: PPAR-alpha is the master regulator of lipid beta-oxidation metabolism. Regulation is the lipid-program control.
context.zh-TW: PPAR-alpha 是脂質 β 氧化代謝的主調控者。調節是脂質程序控制。

context.en-US: PPAR-alpha induces autophagy alongside peroxisome proliferation. Induction couples lipid sensing to clearance.
context.zh-TW: PPAR-alpha 在過氧化物酶體增殖之外誘發自噬。誘發將脂質感知耦合到清除。

context.en-US: Fenofibrate fibrate agonism activates PPAR-alpha. Activation is the pharmacological input.
context.zh-TW: Fenofibrate 貝特促效活化 PPAR-alpha。活化是藥理輸入。

context.en-US: Lipid droplets are delivered to lysosomes for degradation via lipophagy, mirroring selective autophagy of peroxisomes. Targeting is the cargo direction.
context.zh-TW: 脂滴經由脂噬遞送到溶酶體降解，呼應過氧化物酶體的選擇性自噬。標定是貨物方向。

context.en-US: Pexophagy is the peroxisome-specific form of selective autophagy, mirroring mitophagy classification. Classification nests the cargo program.
context.zh-TW: Pexophagy 是過氧化物酶體特異的選擇性自噬形式，呼應粒線體自噬歸類。歸類嵌套貨物程序。

context.en-US: Metformin inhibits complex I to raise AMP:ATP and activate AMPK. Inhibition is the bioenergetic entry.
context.zh-TW: Metformin 抑制複合體 I 以提高 AMP:ATP 並活化 AMPK。抑制是生物能量進入。

context.en-US: Complex I dysfunction generates reactive oxygen species driving senescence signaling. Production is the basal leak direction.
context.zh-TW: 複合體 I 功能障礙產生驅動衰老訊號的活性氧。產生是基礎洩漏方向。

subject: Hypoxia

context.en-US: Autophagy is upregulated in response to hypoxia and HIF stress. Induction is the oxygen-stress route.
context.zh-TW: 自噬在缺氧與 HIF 壓力反應上調。誘發是氧壓力路徑。

context.zh-TW: 禁食營養剝奪訊號經由 mTORC1 抑制解除起始抑制。抑制是禁食關閉開關。
